jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research in a fixed-term role. As a Project Support Associate, you will support clinical trials by coordinating project activities, managing documentation, and contributing to supply chain operations.

Working closely with internal teams and clients, you will help ensure smooth project execution, timely delivery, and high-quality service. The role focuses on project coordination, stakeholder communication, and operational support within a structured and regulated environment.

This is an entry-level position requiring relevant initial professional experience, offering an excellent opportunity to further develop expertise in clinical trials and client services.

REQUIREMENTS:

- Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, supply chain, business, or a related field
- Initial professional experience in clinical trials, clinical supply, logistics, or a related regulated industry
- Experience in coordination, administrative, operational, or client-facing roles
- Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
- Strong organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail
- Ability to coordinate multiple activities and meet timelines in a dynamic environment
- Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
- Analytical mindset with the ability to work with data and support reporting
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel and MS Project)
- Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
- Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
- Proactive, adaptable, and quality-focused approach
- Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

## Programma di lavoro

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Condizioni ambientali

osservanza di tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza, ufficio

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

DESCRIZIONE:

Unisciti al nostro team di Thermo Fisher Scientific e contribuisci a promuovere la ricerca clinica in un ruolo a tempo determinato. In qualità di Project Support Associate, supporterai gli studi clinici coordinando le attività di progetto, gestendo la documentazione e contribuendo alle operazioni di supply chain.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team e i clienti interni, vi aiuterà a garantire l'esecuzione del progetto liscia, la consegna tempestiva e il servizio di alta qualità. Il ruolo si concentra sul coordinamento dei progetti, sulla comunicazione degli stakeholder e sul supporto operativo in un ambiente strutturato e regolamentato.

Si tratta di una posizione entry-level che richiede un'esperienza professionale iniziale rilevante, offrendo un'eccellente opportunità per sviluppare ulteriormente le competenze in studi clinici e servizi client.

PRESCRIZIONI:

- Corso di laurea in scienze della vita, sanità, supply chain, business o un campo correlato
- Esperienza professionale iniziale in studi clinici, fornitura clinica, logistica, o un settore regolamentato relativo
- Esperienza in ruoli di coordinamento, amministrativo, operativo o orientati al cliente
- Certificazione di gestione del progetto da istituzione riconosciuta benefica
• Forte comprensione dei principi GMP/GxP e dei sistemi di gestione della qualità
- Forte capacità organizzative e multitasking con alta attenzione ai dettagli
- Capacità di coordinare più attività e soddisfare le scadenze in un ambiente dinamico
- Esperienza coordinata con i team e gestione delle relazioni con gli stakeholder
- Mindset analitico con la capacità di lavorare con la segnalazione di dati e supporto
- Proficienza negli strumenti Microsoft Office (in particolare Excel e MS Project)
- Esperienza con sistemi aziendali come Salesforce, GPMS e TrackWise preferiti
- Inglese fluente richiesto, lingue aggiuntive benefiche
- Approccio proattivo, adattabile e focalizzato sulla qualità
- I viaggi nei siti dei clienti o in altre strutture possono essere richiesti

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

Beschreibung:

Treten Sie unserem Team von Thermo Fisher Scientific bei und tragen Sie dazu bei, die klinische Forschung in einer befristeten Rolle voranzutreiben. Als Project Support Associate unterstützen Sie klinische Studien, indem Sie Projektaktivitäten koordinieren, die Dokumentation verwalten und zu Lieferkettenoperationen beitragen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und Kunden tragen Sie dazu bei, eine reibungslose Projektabwicklung, zeitnahe Lieferung und qualitativ hochwertigen Service zu gewährleisten. Die Rolle konzentriert sich auf Projektkoordination, Stakeholder-Kommunikation und operative Unterstützung in einem strukturierten und regulierten Umfeld.

Dies ist eine Einstiegsposition, die relevante erste Berufserfahrung erfordert und eine hervorragende Gelegenheit bietet, das Fachwissen in klinischen Studien und Kundendienstleistungen weiterzuentwickeln.

ANFORDERUNGEN:

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Sciences, Gesundheitswesen, Supply Chain, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich
- Erste Berufserfahrung in klinischen Studien, klinischer Versorgung, Logistik oder einer damit verbundenen regulierten Industrie
- Erfahrung in Koordinations-, Verwaltungs-, Betriebs- oder Kundenrollen
- Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung von anerkannten Institution vorteilhaft
• Starkes Verständnis der GMP/GxP-Prinzipien und Qualitätsmanagementsysteme
- Starke organisatorische und Multitasking-Fähigkeiten mit hoher Liebe zum Detail
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Aktivitäten zu koordinieren und Zeitpläne in einer dynamischen Umgebung einzuhalten
- Erfahrung in der Koordination mit Teams und der Verwaltung von Stakeholder-Beziehungen
- Analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mit Daten zu arbeiten und das Reporting zu unterstützen
- Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office-Tools (insbesondere Excel und MS Project)
- Erfahrung mit Unternehmenssystemen wie Salesforce, GPMS und TrackWise bevorzugt
- fließendes Englisch erforderlich, zusätzliche Sprachen vorteilhaft
- Proaktiver, anpassungsfähiger und qualitätsorientierter Ansatz
- Reisen zu Kundenstandorten oder anderen Einrichtungen können erforderlich sein

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.

DESCRIPTION:

Rejoignez notre équipe chez Thermo Fisher Scientific et contribuez à faire progresser la recherche clinique à terme. En tant qu'associé de soutien de projet, vous soutiendrez les essais cliniques en coordonnant les activités du projet, en gérant la documentation et en contribuant aux opérations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes et les clients, vous contribuerez à assurer la bonne exécution du projet, la livraison en temps opportun et un service de haute qualité. Le rôle est axé sur la coordination des projets, la communication avec les intervenants et le soutien opérationnel dans un environnement structuré et réglementé.

Il s'agit d'un poste d'entrée de gamme exigeant une expérience professionnelle initiale pertinente, offrant une excellente occasion de développer davantage l'expertise dans les essais cliniques et les services à la clientèle.

EXIGENCES:

- Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, soins de santé, chaîne d'approvisionnement, affaires ou un domaine connexe
- Expérience professionnelle initiale dans les essais cliniques, l'approvisionnement clinique, la logistique ou une industrie réglementée connexe
- Expérience des rôles de coordination, d'administration, d'exploitation ou de client
- Certification de gestion de projet de l'établissement reconnu bénéfique
• Bonne compréhension des principes des BPF/GxP et des systèmes de gestion de la qualité
- Fortes compétences organisationnelles et multitâches avec une grande attention aux détails
- Capacité de coordonner plusieurs activités et de respecter les délais dans un environnement dynamique
- Expérience en coordination avec les équipes et gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes
- Un état d'esprit analytique avec la capacité de travailler avec les données et de soutenir les rapports
- Compétence des outils Microsoft Office (en particulier Excel et MS Project)
- Expérience avec des systèmes d'entreprise comme Salesforce, GPMS et TrackWise préférés
- Anglais fluent requis, langues supplémentaires bénéfiques
- Approche proactive, adaptable et axée sur la qualité
- Des déplacements vers des sites clients ou d'autres installations peuvent être nécessaires

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Location/Division Specific Information:

This position is part of the Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) team from Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), supporting GMP-regulated manufacturing operations. The role operates within a laboratory environment focused on ensuring microbiological quality and compliance of pharmaceutical products and processes.

## A Day in the Life:

- Coordinate and work on the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Actively contribute to the GMP Inspection Readiness of QC to ensure the fully compliance of relevant Quality System and Procedural documents.
- Actively contribute to the QC operational readiness managing projects (external and internal) and the assigned to ressources (including coordination of people daily tasks). Participates in the transfer, development and validation of analytical methods including qualification of equipment needed for analysis.
- Responsible for development, transfer and validation of analytical procedures professionally and according to timelines.
- Ensure ready to state activities in the MBQC lab.
- Collaboration in the solution of MBQC problematic and / or questions (quality problems, government inquiries, etc.).
- Supporting of laboratory employee during troubleshooting activities.
- Efficient communication: Informing the MBQC head in a timely manner regarding ongoing business activities, deviations, and problems within the team.
- Responsible for writing and revision of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and instructions (Wis) professionally and according to timelines.
- Responsible for SME review and approval of methods, plans, protocols and reports, gap assessments

## Education & Experience:

- Degree (Master or higher) in the Microbiology or Life Science Area
- At least 5 years experience in microbiological laboratories including experience in a regulated GMP environment.

## Knowledge, Abilities:

- Extensive knowledge of microbiological testing techniques (bioburden, endotoxin, qPCR) and laboratory best practices
- Strong knowledge of cGMP requirements, method validation/verification, and documentation standards (SOPs, WIs)
- Ability to troubleshoot microbiological issues, support investigations, and collaborate in cross-functional teams
- Fluent English (written and spoken), German is a plus

## What We Offer:

- Compensation
- Competitive Pay
- Performance Related Bonus where eligible
- Annual merit performance-based increase

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. ## Location/Division Informazioni specifiche:

Questa posizione fa parte del team Microbiological Quality Control (MBQC) di Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), che supporta le operazioni di produzione regolate da GMP. Il ruolo opera all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio mirato a garantire la qualità microbiologica e la conformità dei prodotti e processi farmaceutici.

## Un giorno nella vita:

- Coordinare e lavorare sul trasferimento, lo sviluppo e la convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Contribuire attivamente alla disponibilità di controllo GMP di QC per garantire la piena conformità del relativo sistema di qualità e documenti procedurali.
- Contribuire attivamente ai progetti di gestione della disponibilità operativa QC (esterno e interno) e alle risorse assegnate (compreso il coordinamento delle attività quotidiane delle persone). Partecipa al trasferimento, allo sviluppo e alla convalida di metodi analitici, tra cui la qualificazione di attrezzature necessarie per l'analisi.
- Responsabile per lo sviluppo, il trasferimento e la validazione di procedure analitiche professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Assicurarsi di essere pronti a svolgere attività nel laboratorio MBQC.
- Collaborazione nella soluzione di MBQC problematico e / o domande (problemi di qualità, indagini governative, ecc.).
- Supporto dei dipendenti di laboratorio durante le attività di risoluzione dei problemi.
- Comunicazione efficiente: Informare la testa di MBQC in modo tempestivo sulle attività aziendali in corso, deviazioni e problemi all'interno del team.
- Responsabile per la scrittura e la revisione delle procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni (Wis) professionalmente e secondo tempi.
- Responsabile per la revisione e l'approvazione delle PMI di metodi, piani, protocolli e relazioni, valutazioni dei gap

## Istruzione e esperienza:

- Laurea (Master o superiore) in Microbiologia o Life Science Area
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in laboratori microbiologici tra cui l'esperienza in un ambiente GMP regolamentato.

## Conoscenza, abilità:

- Ampia conoscenza delle tecniche di test microbiologici (bioburden, endotossina, qPCR) e delle best practice di laboratorio
- Forte conoscenza dei requisiti cGMP, convalida dei metodi/verificazione e standard di documentazione (SOP, WIs)
- Capacità di risolvere problemi microbiologici, di sostenere le indagini e di collaborare in team interfunzionali
- Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato), tedesco è un plus

## Cosa offriamo:

- Compensazione
- Paga competitiva
- Prestazioni Bonus Correlato dove idoneo
- Aumento basato sulle prestazioni del merito annuale

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. ## Standort/Bereichsspezifische Angaben:

Diese Position ist Teil des Teams für mikrobiologische Qualitätskontrolle (MBQC) von Thermo Fisher Scientific in Lengnau (CH), das GMP-regulierte Fertigungsbetriebe unterstützt. Die Rolle spielt sich in einer Laborumgebung ab, die sich auf die Gewährleistung der mikrobiologischen Qualität und der Konformität pharmazeutischer Produkte und Prozesse konzentriert.

## Ein Tag im Leben:

- Koordination und Arbeit an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur GMP Inspection Readiness von QC, um die vollständige Einhaltung der relevanten Qualitätssicherungssysteme und Verfahrensunterlagen sicherzustellen.
- Aktiver Beitrag zur QC-Operational Readiness Management-Projekte (extern und intern) und die zugewiesenen Ressourcen (einschließlich der Koordination der täglichen Aufgaben der Menschen). Beteiligt sich an der Übertragung, Entwicklung und Validierung von Analysemethoden, einschließlich der Qualifizierung der für die Analyse benötigten Ausrüstung.
- Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Übertragung und Validierung von analytischen Verfahren professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie bereit sind, Aktivitäten im MBQC-Labor anzugeben.
- Zusammenarbeit bei der Lösung von MBQC-Problemen und / oder Fragen (Qualitätsprobleme, Regierungsanfragen usw.).
- Unterstützung von Labormitarbeitern bei der Fehlersuche.
- Effiziente Kommunikation: rechtzeitige Information des MBQC-Leiters über laufende Geschäftsaktivitäten, Abweichungen und Probleme im Team.
- Verantwortlich für das Schreiben und die Überarbeitung von Standard-Betriebsanweisungen (SOPs) und Anweisungen (Wis) professionell und nach Zeitvorgaben.
- Verantwortlich für die KMU-Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Methoden, Plänen, Protokollen und Berichten, Lückenbewertungen

## Bildung & Erfahrung:

- Grad (Master oder höher) in der Mikrobiologie oder Life Science Area
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in mikrobiologischen Labors, einschließlich Erfahrung in einer regulierten GMP-Umgebung.

## Wissen, Fähigkeiten:

- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über mikrobiologische Testverfahren (Bioburden, Endotoxin, qPCR) und bewährte Laborverfahren
- Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der cGMP-Anforderungen, Methodenvalidierung/-verifizierung und Dokumentationsstandards (SOPs, WIs)
- Fähigkeit, mikrobiologische Probleme zu beheben, Untersuchungen zu unterstützen und in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten
- fließendes Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen), Deutsch ist ein Plus

## Was wir anbieten:

- Ausgleich
- Wettbewerbsfähiges Entgelt
- Leistungsbezogener Bonus, sofern zulässig
- Jährliche leistungsbasierte Steigerung

- Contribuer activement à la préparation opérationnelle du CQ à la gestion des projets (externes et internes) et des ressources affectées (y compris la coordination des tâches quotidiennes des personnes). Participer au transfert, au développement et à la validation des méthodes d'analyse, y compris la qualification de l'équipement nécessaire à l'analyse.
- Responsable du développement, du transfert et de la validation des procédures d'analyse professionnelles et selon les délais.
- Assurez-vous d'être prêt à déclarer les activités dans le laboratoire du MBQC.
- Collaboration à la solution des problèmes et/ou des questions du CQMB (problèmes de qualité, enquêtes gouvernementales, etc.).
- Soutien aux employés de laboratoire pendant les activités de dépannage.
- Communication efficace : Informer le responsable du CQM en temps opportun des activités opérationnelles, des écarts et des problèmes au sein de l'équipe.
- Responsable de la rédaction et de la révision des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et des instructions (Wis) professionnellement et selon les délais.
- Responsable de l ' examen et de l ' approbation par les PME des méthodes, plans, protocoles et rapports, des évaluations des lacunes

## Éducation et expérience :

- Diplôme (maîtrise ou plus) en microbiologie ou sciences de la vie
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans des laboratoires microbiologiques, y compris une expérience dans un environnement BPF réglementé.

## Connaissances, capacités :

- Connaissance approfondie des techniques d'analyse microbiologique (biocharge, endotoxine, qPCR) et des meilleures pratiques de laboratoire
- Connaissance approfondie des exigences des BPFc, de la validation/vérification des méthodes et des normes de documentation (SOP, WI)
- Capacité de résoudre les problèmes microbiologiques, de soutenir les enquêtes et de collaborer dans des équipes interfonctionnelles
- Anglais (écrit et parlé), allemand est un plus

## Ce que nous offrons:

- Rémunération
- Rémunération concurrentielle
- Bonus lié à la performance lorsque admissible
- Augmentation annuelle fondée sur le rendement

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **We are the Clinical Trials Division (CTD): We Supply the Hope that Changes Lives** CTD partners with pharmaceutical and biotech customers around the world to ensure the right patients get the right therapies in the right doses at the right time - a concept that we internally adopt as "There is a Patient Waiting." Our unique blend of services includes project management, packaging, distribution, transportation management and specialty logistics, ancillary supply management, clinical supply optimization, bio-repository storage and much more. Our more than 4000 employees in over 15 countries work hard every day knowing that what they do matters. **Your Role in that Mission: As a member of Global Client Services, you are part of One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results for our customers and their patients.** As the Senior Demand and Supply Manager, you are part of a centralized team that provides specialized technical services to clients as part of our enhanced service offerings. Specifically, this role specializes in providing upfront and ongoing demand planning services for more complex clients or accounts, including early demand plans, global inventory optimization strategies, proactive inventory management, portfolio management, and IRT set-up consultation. This role acts as an informal leader in the Client Services team, supporting strategic development. **Key 
• Responsibilities:** Independently leads the Design, Implement, Interpret and Review inventory management plan to forecast supply plan of study drugs to global and sophisticated clinical trials, using sound supply chain techniques

Informal leader within the team who looks to improve processes, tools, and resources for organization. Provides mentorship and guidance for new hires and less experienced planners and is viewed as a role model leader by peers. Provide input into User Requirement Specifications of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) medication management module and complete User Acceptance Testing if required. Review IRT strategy to ensure it supports the strategic supply plans and that IRT settings are adjusted to optimize the supply and demand Ensures plans are robust and optimizes global and regional supply strategies to ensure continuity of patient supply in the most effective and efficient manner Develop and provide clients with reports on actual project spend versus budget Establishes connections between demand planning team and S&OP to ensure the latest forecast information is aggregated and integrated into the divisional S&OP process Partners with the Enterprise Project Manager, along with global and site project management teams and/or directly with the customer to inform and proactively share key client data necessary to facilitate an effective supply chain planning cycle Ensure temperature excursion process is performed as required Establish and maintain financial forecasts and monthly billing processes for assigned complex client projects Assist in training and on boarding of new employees (buddy concept) Stay on top of relevant cGMPs, GCPs, and other regulatory requirements and ensure study management activities are aligned. Demonstrate and promote company vision. Conduct activities in a safe and efficient manner **As Demonstrated By:  Project Management** Understands the customer’s target market, segmentation, and value proposition. Identifies the client’s needs, distributes those needs, and collects feedback regularly to ensure efforts are meeting their expectation. Structures demand plans in line with client strategy —starting from an identified need, sets objectives and specific goals Speaks and writes in a clear, concise, and organized way. Listens carefully to others to ensure understanding and effective communication. Effectively documents and communicates key learnings so that the client or audience understands.

**Technical Knowledge** Communicates analyses applicable to stakeholders involved and ensures all are informed. Manages demand planning projects efficiently in different systems to provide accurate forecasting information to core team, leadership, and the client. Maintains their own as well as the team’s accountability for using Thermo Fisher tools to help the team be successful. Demonstrates comfort with technology and uses innovations to advance the efficiency and effectiveness of work processes, procedures, and outputs. Leverages tools and technologies to ultimately move the project through its Demand planning phases. **Project Management Leadership** Brings new or alternative perspectives forward to overcome difficulty or uncertainty and builds coalitions. Collaborates well with others and builds effective business relationships with various colleagues while fostering teamwork. **Key 
• Requirements: Education:** Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business/operations management (equivalent work experience may be considered) To foster a sense of belonging and connection, remote employees are expected to keep their camera on and participate in video calls both internally and externally, as appropriate. **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of clinical supply chain and/or planning experience managing global supply chain design and logistics management, preferably as they relate to clinical program design and execution 4+ years experience if holding an advanced degree Understanding of clinical supply requirements, phases of clinical development, and the factors that influence study designs preferred Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Ascolta attentamente gli altri per garantire la comprensione e la comunicazione efficace. Documenta efficacemente e comunica gli insegnamenti chiave in modo che il cliente o il pubblico capisca.

La conoscenza tecnica Comunica le analisi applicabili agli stakeholder coinvolti e assicura che tutti siano informati. Gestisce i progetti di pianificazione della domanda in modo efficiente in diversi sistemi per fornire informazioni di previsione accurate a team core, leadership e il cliente. Mantiene il proprio così come la responsabilità del team per l'utilizzo di strumenti Thermo Fisher per aiutare il team ad avere successo. Dimostra comfort con la tecnologia e utilizza innovazioni per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia dei processi di lavoro, delle procedure e delle uscite. Leva strumenti e tecnologie per spostare il progetto attraverso le sue fasi di pianificazione della domanda. Collabora bene con gli altri e costruisce relazioni commerciali efficaci con vari colleghi, mentre promuove il lavoro di squadra. Key.

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. **We are the Clinical Trials Division (CTD): We Supply the Hope that Changes Lives** CTD partners with pharmaceutical and biotech customers around the world to ensure the right patients get the right therapies in the right doses at the right time - a concept that we internally adopt as "There is a Patient Waiting." Our unique blend of services includes project management, packaging, distribution, transportation management and specialty logistics, ancillary supply management, clinical supply optimization, bio-repository storage and much more. Our more than 4000 employees in over 15 countries work hard every day knowing that what they do matters. **Your Role in that Mission: As a member of Global Client Services, you are part of One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results for our customers and their patients.** As the Senior Demand and Supply Manager, you are part of a centralized team that provides specialized technical services to clients as part of our enhanced service offerings. Specifically, this role specializes in providing upfront and ongoing demand planning services for more complex clients or accounts, including early demand plans, global inventory optimization strategies, proactive inventory management, portfolio management, and IRT set-up consultation. This role acts as an informal leader in the Client Services team, supporting strategic development. **Key 
• Responsibilities:** Independently leads the Design, Implement, Interpret and Review inventory management plan to forecast supply plan of study drugs to global and sophisticated clinical trials, using sound supply chain techniques

Informal leader within the team who looks to improve processes, tools, and resources for organization. Provides mentorship and guidance for new hires and less experienced planners and is viewed as a role model leader by peers. Provide input into User Requirement Specifications of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) medication management module and complete User Acceptance Testing if required. Review IRT strategy to ensure it supports the strategic supply plans and that IRT settings are adjusted to optimize the supply and demand Ensures plans are robust and optimizes global and regional supply strategies to ensure continuity of patient supply in the most effective and efficient manner Develop and provide clients with reports on actual project spend versus budget Establishes connections between demand planning team and S&OP to ensure the latest forecast information is aggregated and integrated into the divisional S&OP process Partners with the Enterprise Project Manager, along with global and site project management teams and/or directly with the customer to inform and proactively share key client data necessary to facilitate an effective supply chain planning cycle Ensure temperature excursion process is performed as required Establish and maintain financial forecasts and monthly billing processes for assigned complex client projects Assist in training and on boarding of new employees (buddy concept) Stay on top of relevant cGMPs, GCPs, and other regulatory requirements and ensure study management activities are aligned. Demonstrate and promote company vision. Conduct activities in a safe and efficient manner **As Demonstrated By:  Project Management** Understands the customer’s target market, segmentation, and value proposition. Identifies the client’s needs, distributes those needs, and collects feedback regularly to ensure efforts are meeting their expectation. Structures demand plans in line with client strategy —starting from an identified need, sets objectives and specific goals Speaks and writes in a clear, concise, and organized way. Listens carefully to others to ensure understanding and effective communication. Effectively documents and communicates key learnings so that the client or audience understands.

**Technical Knowledge** Communicates analyses applicable to stakeholders involved and ensures all are informed. Manages demand planning projects efficiently in different systems to provide accurate forecasting information to core team, leadership, and the client. Maintains their own as well as the team’s accountability for using Thermo Fisher tools to help the team be successful. Demonstrates comfort with technology and uses innovations to advance the efficiency and effectiveness of work processes, procedures, and outputs. Leverages tools and technologies to ultimately move the project through its Demand planning phases. **Project Management Leadership** Brings new or alternative perspectives forward to overcome difficulty or uncertainty and builds coalitions. Collaborates well with others and builds effective business relationships with various colleagues while fostering teamwork. **Key 
• Requirements: Education:** Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business/operations management (equivalent work experience may be considered) To foster a sense of belonging and connection, remote employees are expected to keep their camera on and participate in video calls both internally and externally, as appropriate. **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of clinical supply chain and/or planning experience managing global supply chain design and logistics management, preferably as they relate to clinical program design and execution 4+ years experience if holding an advanced degree Understanding of clinical supply requirements, phases of clinical development, and the factors that influence study designs preferred Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer. **Nous sommes la Division des essais cliniques (DCT) : Nous donnons l'espoir que des changements surviennent** La DTC collabore avec des clients pharmaceutiques et biotechnologiques du monde entier pour s'assurer que les bons patients reçoivent les bonnes thérapies aux bonnes doses au bon moment - un concept que nous adoptons à l'interne comme « Il y a un patient en attente ». Notre combinaison unique de services comprend la gestion de projet, l'emballage, la distribution, la gestion du transport et la logistique spécialisée, la gestion de l'approvisionnement auxiliaire, l'optimisation de l'approvisionnement clinique, le stockage bio-résistant et bien plus encore. Nos plus de 4000 employés dans plus de 15 pays travaillent dur chaque jour en sachant que ce qu'ils font est important. **Votre rôle dans cette mission : En tant que membre de Global Client Services, vous faites partie de One Global Team: Empowered to Act, Make Connections and Get Results pour nos clients et leurs patients.** En tant que gestionnaire principal de la demande et de l'offre, vous faites partie d'une équipe centralisée qui fournit des services techniques spécialisés aux clients dans le cadre de nos offres de services améliorées. Plus précisément, ce rôle se spécialise dans la prestation de services de planification de la demande initiale et continue pour des clients ou des comptes plus complexes, y compris des plans de demande précoce, des stratégies d'optimisation des stocks mondiaux, une gestion proactive des stocks, la gestion de portefeuille et la consultation sur la mise en place de l'IRT. Ce rôle agit comme chef de file informel au sein de l'équipe des Services à la clientèle, appuyant le développement stratégique. ** Clé
• Responsabilités** Dirige indépendamment le plan de gestion de l'inventaire de conception, de mise en oeuvre, d'interprétation et d'examen pour prévoir le plan d'approvisionnement des médicaments d'étude aux essais cliniques mondiaux et sophistiqués, en utilisant des techniques de chaîne d'approvisionnement saines

Leader informel au sein de l'équipe qui cherche à améliorer les processus, les outils et les ressources pour l'organisation. Fournit du mentorat et de l'orientation aux nouveaux employés et aux planificateurs moins expérimentés et est considéré comme un chef de file modèle par les pairs. Fournir des renseignements sur les exigences de l'utilisateur Spécifications de la technologie de réponse interactive (TIR) module de gestion des médicaments et terminer les tests d'acceptation de l'utilisateur au besoin. Examiner la stratégie de l'IRT pour s'assurer qu'elle appuie les plans d'approvisionnement stratégiques et que les paramètres de l'IRT sont ajustés pour optimiser l'offre et la demande. Veiller à ce que les plans soient robustes et optimiser les stratégies d'approvisionnement mondiales et régionales afin d'assurer la continuité de l'approvisionnement des patients de la manière la plus efficace et la plus efficiente. Élaborer et fournir aux clients des rapports sur les dépenses réelles du projet par rapport au budget. Établir des liens entre l'équipe de planification de la demande et les S&OP afin de s'assurer que les données les plus récentes sur les prévisions sont regroupées et intégrées au processus de S&OP de la division. Restez au-dessus des BPF, des BPF et des autres exigences réglementaires pertinentes et veillez à ce que les activités de gestion des études soient harmonisées. Démontrer et promouvoir la vision de l'entreprise. Mener des activités de façon sécuritaire et efficace **Comme l'a démontré : Gestion de projet** Comprend le marché cible, la segmentation et la proposition de valeur. Indique les besoins du client, distribue ces besoins et recueille des commentaires régulièrement pour s'assurer que les efforts répondent à leurs attentes. Les structures exigent des plans conformes à la stratégie du client — en partant d'un besoin identifié, en fixant des objectifs et des buts précis. Écoute attentivement les autres pour assurer la compréhension et une communication efficace. Documenter efficacement et communiquer les principaux apprentissages afin que le client ou le public comprenne.

**Connaissances techniques** Communiquer les analyses applicables aux intervenants concernés et s'assurer que tous sont informés. Gérer efficacement les projets de planification de la demande dans différents systèmes afin de fournir des renseignements précis sur les prévisions à l'équipe centrale, au leadership et au client. Maintient sa propre responsabilité ainsi que celle de l'équipe d'utiliser les outils Thermo Fisher pour aider l'équipe à réussir. Démontrer le confort avec la technologie et utiliser des innovations pour améliorer l'efficience et l'efficacité des processus, des procédures et des extrants de travail. Exploiter les outils et les technologies pour faire passer le projet en phase de planification de la demande. ** Leadership en gestion de projets** Apporte des perspectives nouvelles ou alternatives pour surmonter les difficultés ou l'incertitude et construit des coalitions. Collabore bien avec les autres et établit des relations d'affaires efficaces avec divers collègues tout en favorisant le travail d'équipe. ** Clé
• Exigences : Éducation** Baccalauréat en chaîne d'approvisionnement, gestion des affaires et des opérations (une expérience de travail équivalente peut être envisagée) Pour favoriser un sentiment d'appartenance et de connexion, les employés distants sont censés garder leur appareil photo allumé et participer à des appels vidéo à l'interne et à l'externe, selon le cas. **Années d'expérience :** 5+ ans d'expérience clinique en matière de chaîne d'approvisionnement et/ou de planification en gestion de la conception et de la gestion logistique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale, de préférence en ce qui a trait à la conception et à l'exécution de programmes cliniques 4+ ans d'expérience si elle possède un degré avancé Comprendre les besoins cliniques en matière d'approvisionnement, les phases de développement clinique et les facteurs qui influent sur les conceptions d'études préférées Thermo Fisher Scientific est un Employeur d'EEO/Affirmative Action et ne fait aucune discrimination fondée sur la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité sexuelle, l'origine nationale, le statut d'ancien combattant protégé, l'invalidité ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

The Senior Technical Sales Specialist (TSS) for Single-Use Technologies is a role within the sales organization of the BioProduction Group. This role will actively handle funnel opportunities for near-term revenue gains and develop new opportunities to build a strong pipeline for future growth, while maintaining current business relationships and organic growth. This individual will apply their sales experience, bioprocess knowledge, product expertise, market intelligence, and territory leadership skills to grow sales and profitability.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Searches for new opportunities and uses product portfolio to build a foundation for long term growth
- Drives existing funnel of opportunities to accelerate closure rates
- Applies intelligence-based prospecting to identify new potential opportunities
- Prioritizes New Product Introduction (NPI) prospects within territory to improve adoption rates and revenue return
- Acts on marketing-qualified leads, quickly converting to new opportunities
- Collaborates with and influences Bioproduction Account Managers (BAMs) and Field Application Scientists (FAS) within their district to develop and lead account growth strategies
- Assists all BioProduction Account Managers within assigned territory with sales and account planning efforts to achieve sales goals
- Aids in development of technical solution-matching for complex opportunities
- Maintains and improves technical knowledge on assigned product lines, company literature, and driven products

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in a life-science related field required, such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or Engineering
- 7+ years of combined sales or adjacent functional experience working in a role related to the bioproduction process. Single Use preferred
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and departments
- Technical understanding of bioproduction workflows and applications
- Shows good judgment and tact when dealing with internal and external customers
- Must possess strong understanding of customer challenges and solution development
- Expert presentation and communication skills with ability to engage stakeholders

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Description:** Join our quality team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll make a meaningful impact ensuring product quality and regulatory compliance across our pharmaceutical and scientific operations. As a Senior Quality Specialist, you'll be responsible for ensuring GxP equipment and computerized system compliance for Fisher Clinical Services Switzerland (Basel) and Germany (Rheinfelden and Weil am Rhein) sites. The role provides Quality Assurance leadership for Computer System Validation (CSV), Data Integrity, and IT compliance activities while ensuring alignment with global GMP requirements. The successful candidate partners with cross-functional teams to drive quality excellence, oversee validation lifecycle activities, support inspections and audits, and maintain robust quality systems that enable Thermo Fisher Scientific's mission. **Responsibilities:**

- Serve as the Quality Assurance subject matter expert for IT systems, computerized systems, equipment qualification, and Computer System Validation (CSV).
- Review and approve validation lifecycle documentation including URS, risk assessments, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, PQ, validation plans, protocols, reports, and periodic reviews.
- Provide oversight of qualification and validation activities to ensure systems remain in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.
- Lead or support investigations, root cause analyses, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments related to computerized systems and equipment.
- Ensure compliance with Data Integrity principles, global GMP requirements, FDA/EMA regulations, 21 CFR Parts 210/211, applicable GAMP and ICH guidance.
- Review and approve SOPs, deviations, validation templates, and quality documentation supporting GxP systems.
- Track periodic reviews and audit trail reviews for computerized systems.
- Represent Quality during customer audits, regulatory inspections, and internal audits; support inspection readiness and responses.
- Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Validation, IT, and Operations to drive continuous improvement and compliance initiatives.
- Provide technical guidance and mentoring on validation, quality systems, and regulatory expectations.

## Qualifications:

- Quality Assurance experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
- Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
- Demonstrated experience in Computer System Validation (CSV), equipment qualification, and quality oversight of GxP computerized systems.
- Strong knowledge of FDA, EMA, global GMP regulations, 21 CFR Parts 210/211, Data Integrity, and ICH/GAMP guidance.
- Hands-on experience with investigations, CAPAs, change control, document management, and quality risk management methodologies.
- Experience supporting regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal audit programs.
- Knowledge of computerized system periodic reviews, audit trail reviews, and computer system lifecycle management.
- Excellent technical writing, communication, analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across diverse cross-functional teams.
- Computer System Validation expertise, German language skills, and Computer System Validation/Data Integrity specialization are considered advantageous.
- Fluency in English is required.

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

Descrizione: Unisciti al nostro team di qualità presso Thermo Fisher Scientific, dove potrai avere un impatto significativo per garantire la qualità del prodotto e la conformità normativa nelle nostre operazioni farmaceutiche e scientifiche. In qualità di Senior Quality Specialist, sarete responsabili di garantire l'attrezzatura GxP e la conformità computerizzata del sistema ai siti Fisher Clinical Services Svizzera (Basel) e Germania (Rheinfelden e Weil am Rhein). Il ruolo fornisce la leadership di Quality Assurance per la convalida del sistema informatico (CSV), l'integrità dei dati e le attività di conformità IT garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con i requisiti globali GMP. I partner di successo con team interfunzionali per guidare l'eccellenza della qualità, supervisionare le attività di validazione del ciclo di vita, sostenere le ispezioni e gli audit, e mantenere sistemi di qualità robusti che consentono la missione di Thermo Fisher Scientific. Responsabilità:

- Servire come esperto di materia di assicurazione della qualità per i sistemi IT, sistemi informatici, qualificazione delle attrezzature e convalida del sistema informatico (CSV).
- Valutazione e approvazione della documentazione del ciclo di vita tra cui URS, valutazioni di rischio, FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, PQ, piani di validazione, protocolli, report e recensioni periodiche.
- Fornire la supervisione delle attività di qualificazione e validazione per garantire che i sistemi rimangano in uno stato convalidato durante il loro ciclo di vita.
- Indagini di piombo o di supporto, analisi di causa radice, CAPAs, controlli di cambiamento e valutazioni di rischio relative a sistemi informatici e attrezzature.
- Assicurare il rispetto dei principi di Integrità dei dati, requisiti GMP globali, regolamenti FDA/EMA, 21 CFR Parti 210/211, GAMP applicabile e ICH guida.
- Recensione e approvazione SOP, deviazioni, modelli di validazione e documentazione di qualità che supporta i sistemi GxP.
- Traccia recensioni periodiche e revisioni dei trail di audit per sistemi informatizzati.
- Rappresentare la qualità durante i controlli dei clienti, le ispezioni regolamentari e gli audit interni; supporto di verifica e risposte.
- Collabora con Engineering, Manufacturing, Validation, IT e Operations per promuovere iniziative di miglioramento e conformità continue.
- Fornire assistenza tecnica e mentoring su convalida, sistemi di qualità e aspettative normative.

## Qualifiche:

- Esperienza di assicurazione della qualità in un ambiente farmaceutico o biotecnologico regolamentato da GMP.
- Laurea in Chimica, Biologia, Microbiologia, Ingegneria, Informatica, o un'altra disciplina scientifica o tecnica rilevante.
- Esperienza dimostrata nella convalida del sistema informatico (CSV), nella qualificazione delle attrezzature e nella supervisione della qualità dei sistemi computerizzati GxP.
- Forte conoscenza delle normative FDA, EMA, GMP globali, 21 CFR Parti 210/211, Integrità dei dati e ICH/GAMP guida.
- Esperienza pratica con indagini, CAPAs, controllo dei cambiamenti, gestione dei documenti e metodologie di gestione dei rischi di qualità.
- Esperienza di supporto controlli normativi, controlli dei clienti e programmi di audit interni.
- Conoscenza di revisioni periodiche del sistema computerizzato, recensioni dei percorsi di audit e gestione del ciclo di vita del sistema informatico.
- Eccellente scrittura tecnica, comunicazione, analitica, gestione del progetto e capacità di problem solving.
- Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mentre si collabora efficacemente attraverso diverse squadre interfunzionali.
- Le competenze di convalida del sistema informatico, le competenze linguistiche tedesche e la convalida del sistema informatico/specializzazione dell'integrità dati sono considerate vantaggiose.
- È richiesta una fluidità in inglese.

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

**Beschreibung:** Treten Sie unserem Qualitätsteam von Thermo Fisher Scientific bei, wo Sie einen bedeutenden Beitrag zur Gewährleistung der Produktqualität und der Einhaltung der Vorschriften in unseren pharmazeutischen und wissenschaftlichen Betrieben leisten. Als Senior Quality Specialist sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, die Konformität von GxP-Geräten und Computersystemen für Fisher Clinical Services Schweiz (Basel) und Deutschland (Rheinfelden und Weil am Rhein) sicherzustellen. Die Rolle stellt die Qualitätssicherungsführerschaft für Computersystemvalidierung (CSV), Datenintegrität und IT-Compliance-Aktivitäten dar und gewährleistet gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung auf globale GMP-Anforderungen. ## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.

**Description :** Rejoignez notre équipe de qualité chez Thermo Fisher Scientific, où vous aurez un impact significatif sur la qualité des produits et la conformité réglementaire dans nos activités pharmaceutiques et scientifiques. En tant que spécialiste principal de la qualité, vous serez chargé d'assurer la conformité des équipements GxP et des systèmes informatisés pour les sites Fisher Clinical Services Suisse (Bâle) et Allemagne (Rheinfelden et Weil am Rhein). Ce rôle assure un leadership en matière d'assurance de la qualité pour les activités de validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV), d'intégrité des données et de conformité à la TI, tout en assurant l'harmonisation avec les exigences mondiales en matière de BPF. Le candidat retenu s'associe à des équipes interfonctionnelles pour favoriser l'excellence en matière de qualité, superviser les activités de validation du cycle de vie, appuyer les inspections et les vérifications et maintenir des systèmes de qualité robustes qui permettent la mission de Thermo Fisher Scientific. ** Responsabilités :**

- Servir d'expert en assurance de la qualité pour les systèmes informatiques, les systèmes informatisés, la qualification de l'équipement et la validation du système informatique (CSV).
- Examiner et approuver la documentation sur le cycle de vie de la validation, y compris l'URS, les évaluations des risques, la FAT, la SAT, le QI, le QO, le QP, les plans de validation, les protocoles, les rapports et les examens périodiques.
- Assurer la surveillance des activités de qualification et de validation afin de s'assurer que les systèmes demeurent dans un état validé tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
- Mener ou appuyer des enquêtes, des analyses des causes profondes, des APC, des contrôles des changements et des évaluations des risques liés aux systèmes et au matériel informatisés.
- Assurer la conformité aux principes d'intégrité des données, aux exigences mondiales en matière de BPF, aux règlements FDA/EMA, aux 21 parties CFR 210/211, GAMP et ICH applicables.
- Examiner et approuver les SOP, les écarts, les modèles de validation et la documentation de qualité appuyant les systèmes GxP.
- Suivre les examens périodiques et les examens des pistes de vérification des systèmes informatisés.
- Représenter la qualité au cours des vérifications des clients, des inspections réglementaires et des vérifications internes; appuyer la préparation et les réponses aux inspections.
- Collaborer avec l'ingénierie, la fabrication, la validation, la TI et les opérations pour mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue et de conformité.
- Fournir des conseils techniques et du mentorat sur la validation, les systèmes de qualité et les attentes en matière de réglementation.

## Qualifications

- Expérience en assurance de la qualité dans un environnement pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique réglementé par les BPF.
- Diplôme en chimie, biologie, microbiologie, génie, informatique ou autre discipline scientifique ou technique pertinente.
- Expérience démontrée en validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV), qualification de l'équipement et surveillance de la qualité des systèmes informatisés GxP.
- Forte connaissance de la FDA, de l'EMA, des règlements mondiaux sur les BPF, 21 parties CFR 210/211, Intégrité des données et des lignes directrices de l'ICH/GAMP.
- Expérience pratique des enquêtes, des APC, du contrôle du changement, de la gestion des documents et des méthodes de gestion des risques de qualité.
- Expérience à l'appui des inspections réglementaires, des vérifications des clients et des programmes de vérification interne.
- Connaissance des examens périodiques des systèmes informatisés, des examens des pistes de vérification et de la gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes informatiques.
- Excellente compétence en rédaction technique, communication, analyse, gestion de projet et résolution de problèmes.
- Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en collaborant efficacement entre diverses équipes interfonctionnelles.
- L'expertise en validation de système informatique, les compétences linguistiques en allemand et la spécialisation en validation de système informatique/intégrité des données sont considérées comme avantageuses.
- La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

## Job Summary:

This position is responsible for ensuring operational EHS at the site and actively supports the implementation of EHS regulations and corporate requirements at the site level through various projects.

This position is also responsible for compliance with environmental regulations and emergency measures at the site and supports the site's operations and warehouse with fire protection and corresponding emergency planning. The EHS Sr. Specialist is the main point of contact for chemical accident and fire prevention at the site level within the framework of various projects.

The EHS Sr. Specialist works closely with all departments, by creating risk assessments, storage and preservation concepts, and training staff in safe behaviour.

## Main tasks:

- You support the departments in the implementation of EHS guidelines based on corporate requirements as well as national and local Swiss regulations.
- You support and advise departments and functional managers regarding EHS guidelines, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
- You monitor and ensure the effectiveness of EHS standards on site by conducting regular inspections.
- You take on the management of operational occupational hygiene and coordinate monitoring campaigns with external service providers.
- You create a prevention program and conduct EHS training, advertising, and communication to improve employees' awareness and competence in the EHS area.
- You ensure the introduction and targeted training of new tools - especially digital tools - that are to be used by employees at the site.
- You lead the Safety Committee at the site, which is composed of representatives from various departments.
- You will work closely with the energy team at the site to drive energy-saving projects forward.
- Together with FM, you will develop and maintain an effective training plan for contractors.
- You prepare exercises and ensure the effectiveness of emergency measures.
- You support and advise the warehouse in creating an appropriate storage concept.
- You take over the management of the first aid organization on site and train staff in firefighting and emergency measures.
- You organize and lead the emergency response team (evacuations)
- Together with facility management, you support the maintenance, inspection, and documentation of safety equipment on site, in particular
- Sprinkler system
- First aid equipment
- Fire alarm system
- You participate in the annual review of risk management and the claims insurance advisor.
- You conduct campaigns for fire and emergency prevention.
- You are part of the on-site emergency team.
- No travel requirements

## Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related field, with additional training in Occupational Safety, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- At least 5 years of experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
- Strong knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations.
- Experience in the chemical and/or pharmaceutical industry.
- Experience in occupational/industrial hygiene.
- Knowledge of biological hazards and biosafety is an advantage.
- Demonstrated ability to drive EHS initiatives, proactively engage relevant stakeholders, and foster a strong safety culture across the organization.
- Applies a practical and solution-focused mindset to support business objectives while consistently upholding regulatory and company standards.
- Acts as a trusted EHS advisor and primary point of contact, providing timely, practical, and effective guidance on EHS-related questions and challenges.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, both vertically and cross-functionally.
- Strong training, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple stakeholders and competing demands.
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Fluent in German with good English language skills.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and achieve goals within demanding timelines.

## Descrizione del lavoro

## Riepilogo del lavoro:

Questa posizione è responsabile di garantire l'EHS operativo sul sito e supporta attivamente l'implementazione di normative EHS e requisiti aziendali a livello del sito attraverso vari progetti.

Questa posizione è anche responsabile del rispetto delle normative ambientali e delle misure di emergenza sul sito e supporta le operazioni del sito e il magazzino con protezione antincendio e corrispondente pianificazione di emergenza. Lo specialista EHS Sr. è il punto principale di contatto per incidenti chimici e prevenzione antincendio a livello del sito nell'ambito di vari progetti.

Lo specialista EHS Sr. lavora a stretto contatto con tutti i dipartimenti, creando valutazioni di rischio, concetti di conservazione e conservazione e personale di formazione in comportamento sicuro.

## Principali compiti:

- L'utente sostiene i dipartimenti nell'attuazione delle linee guida EHS in base alle esigenze aziendali e alle normative svizzere nazionali e locali.
- L'utente supporta e consiglia i dipartimenti e i gestori funzionali per quanto riguarda le linee guida, le procedure, gli standard e i requisiti normativi.
- Monitorare e garantire l'efficacia degli standard EHS in loco conducendo ispezioni regolari.
- Accetti la gestione dell'igiene del lavoro e coordina le campagne di monitoraggio con i fornitori di servizi esterni.
- Creare un programma di prevenzione e condurre la formazione, la pubblicità e la comunicazione EHS per migliorare la consapevolezza e la competenza dei dipendenti nell'area EHS.
- Assicura l'introduzione e la formazione mirata di nuovi strumenti - soprattutto strumenti digitali - che devono essere utilizzati dai dipendenti del sito.
- Lei guida il comitato di sicurezza sul sito, che è composto da rappresentanti di vari dipartimenti.
- Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di energia del sito per guidare i progetti di risparmio energetico in avanti.
- Insieme con FM, si svilupperà e manterrà un piano di formazione efficace per gli appaltatori.
- Preparate gli esercizi e assicurate l'efficacia delle misure di emergenza.
- Supporta e consiglia il magazzino nella creazione di un concetto di storage appropriato.
- Si prende il controllo della gestione della prima organizzazione di aiuti sul sito e il personale di treno in misure antincendio e di emergenza.
- Si organizza e guida il team di risposta di emergenza (evacuazioni)
- Insieme alla gestione delle strutture, supporta la manutenzione, l'ispezione e la documentazione delle attrezzature di sicurezza in loco, in particolare
- Sistema di spruzzi
- Attrezzature di pronto soccorso
- Sistema di allarme antincendio
- Partecipa alla revisione annuale della gestione del rischio e del consulente di assicurazione crediti.
- Conduci campagne di prevenzione incendi e di emergenza.
- Fai parte del team di emergenza in loco.
- Nessun requisito di viaggio

## Requisiti/Qualificazioni:

- Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Chimica, Scienze Ambientali, o un campo correlato, con formazione aggiuntiva in Sicurezza del Lavoro, o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e esperienza professionale.
- Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS).
- Forte conoscenza delle normative locali in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.
- Esperienza nell'industria chimica e/o farmaceutica.
- Esperienza nell'igiene professionale/industriale.
- La conoscenza dei pericoli biologici e della biosicurezza è un vantaggio.
- Dimostrata capacità di guidare iniziative EHS, coinvolgere proattivamente le parti interessate pertinenti e promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza in tutta l'organizzazione.
- Si basa su una mentalità pratica e orientata alla soluzione per supportare gli obiettivi aziendali, mantenendo costantemente gli standard normativi e aziendali.
- Agisce come consulente EHS di fiducia e punto di contatto primario, fornendo una guida tempestiva, pratica ed efficace sulle domande e le sfide relative alla EHS.
- Prove capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, sia verticalmente che cross-funzionalmente.
- Forte formazione, coaching e capacità di problem solving.
- Eccellente capacità organizzativa con la capacità di priorità in modo efficace e gestire più stakeholder e richieste concorrenti.
- Competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione eccezionali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta.
- Fluente in tedesco con buone abilità di lingua inglese.
- Automotivata con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, prendere la proprietà e raggiungere gli obiettivi entro tempi difficili.

## Job Description

## Job Summary:

This position is responsible for ensuring operational EHS at the site and actively supports the implementation of EHS regulations and corporate requirements at the site level through various projects.

This position is also responsible for compliance with environmental regulations and emergency measures at the site and supports the site's operations and warehouse with fire protection and corresponding emergency planning. The EHS Sr. Specialist is the main point of contact for chemical accident and fire prevention at the site level within the framework of various projects.

The EHS Sr. Specialist works closely with all departments, by creating risk assessments, storage and preservation concepts, and training staff in safe behaviour.

## Main tasks:

- You support the departments in the implementation of EHS guidelines based on corporate requirements as well as national and local Swiss regulations.
- You support and advise departments and functional managers regarding EHS guidelines, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
- You monitor and ensure the effectiveness of EHS standards on site by conducting regular inspections.
- You take on the management of operational occupational hygiene and coordinate monitoring campaigns with external service providers.
- You create a prevention program and conduct EHS training, advertising, and communication to improve employees' awareness and competence in the EHS area.
- You ensure the introduction and targeted training of new tools - especially digital tools - that are to be used by employees at the site.
- You lead the Safety Committee at the site, which is composed of representatives from various departments.
- You will work closely with the energy team at the site to drive energy-saving projects forward.
- Together with FM, you will develop and maintain an effective training plan for contractors.
- You prepare exercises and ensure the effectiveness of emergency measures.
- You support and advise the warehouse in creating an appropriate storage concept.
- You take over the management of the first aid organization on site and train staff in firefighting and emergency measures.
- You organize and lead the emergency response team (evacuations)
- Together with facility management, you support the maintenance, inspection, and documentation of safety equipment on site, in particular
- Sprinkler system
- First aid equipment
- Fire alarm system
- You participate in the annual review of risk management and the claims insurance advisor.
- You conduct campaigns for fire and emergency prevention.
- You are part of the on-site emergency team.
- No travel requirements

## Requirements/Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, or a related field, with additional training in Occupational Safety, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
- At least 5 years of experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
- Strong knowledge of local occupational health and safety regulations.
- Experience in the chemical and/or pharmaceutical industry.
- Experience in occupational/industrial hygiene.
- Knowledge of biological hazards and biosafety is an advantage.
- Demonstrated ability to drive EHS initiatives, proactively engage relevant stakeholders, and foster a strong safety culture across the organization.
- Applies a practical and solution-focused mindset to support business objectives while consistently upholding regulatory and company standards.
- Acts as a trusted EHS advisor and primary point of contact, providing timely, practical, and effective guidance on EHS-related questions and challenges.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, both vertically and cross-functionally.
- Strong training, coaching, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple stakeholders and competing demands.
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
- Excellent oral and written communication skills.
- Fluent in German with good English language skills.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, take ownership, and achieve goals within demanding timelines.

## Arbeitsübersicht:

Diese Position ist verantwortlich für die Sicherstellung des operativen EHS am Standort und unterstützt aktiv die Umsetzung von EHS-Vorschriften und Unternehmensanforderungen auf Standortebene durch verschiedene Projekte.

Diese ist auch für die Einhaltung von Umweltauflagen und Notfallmaßnahmen am Standort verantwortlich und unterstützt den Betrieb und das Lager mit Brandschutz und entsprechender Notfallplanung. Der EHS Sr. Specialist ist im Rahmen verschiedener Projekte die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Chemieunfall- und Brandschutz auf Standortebene.

Der EHS Senior Specialist arbeitet eng mit allen Abteilungen zusammen, indem er Risikobewertungen, Lager- und Konservierungskonzepte erstellt und das Personal in sicherem Verhalten ausbildet.

## Hauptaufgaben:

- Sie unterstützen die Abteilungen bei der Umsetzung von EHS-Richtlinien basierend auf Unternehmensanforderungen sowie nationalen und lokalen Schweizer Vorschriften.
- Sie unterstützen und beraten Abteilungen und Funktionsmanager in Bezug auf EHS-Richtlinien, Verfahren, Standards und regulatorische Anforderungen.
- Sie überwachen und gewährleisten die Wirksamkeit der EHS-Standards vor Ort durch regelmäßige Inspektionen.
- Sie übernehmen das Management der betrieblichen Arbeitshygiene und koordinieren Monitoring-Kampagnen mit externen Dienstleistern.
- Sie erstellen ein Präventionsprogramm und führen EHS-Schulungen, Werbung und Kommunikation durch, um das Bewusstsein und die Kompetenz der Mitarbeiter im EHS-Bereich zu verbessern.
- Sie sorgen für die Einführung und gezielte Schulung neuer Tools – insbesondere digitaler Tools –, die von Mitarbeitern vor Ort eingesetzt werden sollen.
- Sie leiten den Sicherheitsausschuss vor Ort, der sich aus Vertretern verschiedener Abteilungen zusammensetzt.
- Sie werden eng mit dem Energieteam vor Ort zusammenarbeiten, um Energiesparprojekte voranzutreiben.
- Zusammen mit FM entwickeln und pflegen Sie einen effektiven Schulungsplan für Auftragnehmer.
- Sie bereiten Übungen vor und gewährleisten die Wirksamkeit von Notfallmaßnahmen.
- Sie unterstützen und beraten das Lager bei der Erstellung eines passenden Lagerkonzepts.
- Sie übernehmen die Leitung der Erste-Hilfe-Organisation vor Ort und schulen Mitarbeiter in Brandbekämpfungs- und Notfallmaßnahmen.
- Sie organisieren und leiten das Notfallteam (Evakuierungen)
- Gemeinsam mit dem Facility Management unterstützen Sie insbesondere die Wartung, Inspektion und Dokumentation von Sicherheitseinrichtungen vor Ort.
- Sprinkleranlage
- Erste-Hilfe-Ausrüstung
- Brandmeldeanlage
- Sie nehmen an der jährlichen Überprüfung des Risikomanagements und des Schadenversicherungsberaters teil.
- Sie führen Kampagnen zur Brand- und Notfallprävention durch.
- Sie sind Teil des Notfallteams vor Ort.
- Keine Reiseanforderungen

## Anforderungen/Qualifikationen:

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Chemie, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit zusätzlicher Ausbildung in Arbeitssicherheit oder einer gleichwertigen Kombination aus Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung.
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Umwelt, Gesundheit und Sicherheit (EHS).
- Fundierte Kenntnisse der lokalen Arbeitsschutz- und Gesundheitsvorschriften.
- Erfahrung in der chemischen und/oder pharmazeutischen Industrie.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeits-/Industriehygiene.
- Die Kenntnis der biologischen Gefahren und der biologischen Sicherheit ist von Vorteil.
- Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, EHS-Initiativen voranzutreiben, relevante Interessengruppen proaktiv einzubeziehen und eine starke Sicherheitskultur im gesamten Unternehmen zu fördern.
- Wendet eine praktische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise an, um Geschäftsziele zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig die regulatorischen und Unternehmensstandards konsequent einzuhalten.
- Funktioniert als vertrauenswürdiger EHS-Berater und primärer Ansprechpartner und bietet zeitnahe, praktische und effektive Anleitung zu Fragen und Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit EHS.
- Bewährte Fähigkeit, Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu beeinflussen, sowohl vertikal als auch funktionsübergreifend.
- Starkes Training, Coaching und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
- Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv zu priorisieren und mehrere Stakeholder und konkurrierende Anforderungen zu verwalten.
- Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv auf allen organisatorischen Ebenen zusammenzuarbeiten.
- Hervorragende mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
