## Résumé de l'emploi :

Ce poste est chargé d'assurer l'ESE opérationnelle au site et appuie activement la mise en oeuvre des règlements sur l'ESE et des exigences ministérielles au niveau du site par le biais de divers projets.

Ce poste est également responsable de la conformité avec la réglementation environnementale et les mesures d'urgence sur le site et soutient les opérations et l'entrepôt du site avec la protection contre les incendies et la planification d'urgence correspondante. Le spécialiste EHS est le principal point de contact pour les accidents chimiques et la prévention des incendies au niveau du site dans le cadre de divers projets.

Le spécialiste EHS Sr. travaille en étroite collaboration avec tous les ministères, en créant des évaluations des risques, des concepts de stockage et de préservation et en formant le personnel à un comportement sécuritaire.

## Principales tâches:

- Vous accompagnez les départements dans la mise en œuvre des directives EHS basées sur les exigences de l'entreprise ainsi que sur les réglementations suisses nationales et locales.
- Vous aidez et conseillez les ministères et les gestionnaires fonctionnels au sujet des lignes directrices, des procédures, des normes et des exigences réglementaires en matière de SSE.
- Vous surveillez et vous assurez de l'efficacité des normes EHS sur place en effectuant des inspections régulières.
- Vous prenez en charge la gestion de l'hygiène opérationnelle et coordonnez les campagnes de suivi avec les prestataires de services externes.
- Vous créez un programme de prévention et effectuez de la formation, de la publicité et de la communication sur l'ESS afin d'améliorer la sensibilisation et la compétence des employés dans le domaine de l'ESS.
- Vous assurez l'introduction et la formation ciblée de nouveaux outils - en particulier des outils numériques - qui seront utilisés par les employés sur le site.
- Vous dirigez le comité de sécurité sur le site, qui est composé de représentants de différents départements.
- Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe énergétique du site pour faire avancer les projets d'économie d'énergie.
- Avec FM, vous élaborerez et maintiendrez un plan de formation efficace pour les entrepreneurs.
- Vous préparez des exercices et assurez l'efficacité des mesures d'urgence.
- Vous aidez et conseillez l'entrepôt en créant un concept de stockage approprié.
- Vous prenez en charge la gestion de l'organisme de premiers soins sur place et formez le personnel à la lutte contre les incendies et aux mesures d'urgence.
- Vous organisez et dirigez l'équipe d'intervention d'urgence (évacuations)
- En plus de la gestion de l'installation, vous soutenez l'entretien, l'inspection et la documentation de l'équipement de sécurité sur place, en particulier
- Système d'arrosage
- Matériel de premiers secours
- Système d'alarme incendie
- Vous participez à l'examen annuel de la gestion des risques et du conseiller en assurance des sinistres.
- Vous mènez des campagnes de prévention des incendies et des urgences.
- Vous faites partie de l'équipe d'urgence sur place.
- Pas de frais de voyage

## Exigences/Qualifications

- Baccalauréat en génie, chimie, sciences de l'environnement, ou un domaine connexe, avec une formation supplémentaire en sécurité au travail, ou une combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience professionnelle.
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en environnement, santé et sécurité (SHS).
- Bonne connaissance des règlements locaux en matière de santé et de sécurité au travail.
- Expérience dans l'industrie chimique et/ou pharmaceutique.
- Expérience en hygiène du travail/industrielle.
- La connaissance des dangers biologiques et de la biosécurité est un avantage.
- Capacité démontrée de diriger des initiatives en matière de SHE, d'engager activement les intervenants pertinents et de favoriser une solide culture de sécurité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
- Applique un état d'esprit pratique et axé sur la solution pour soutenir les objectifs commerciaux tout en respectant les normes réglementaires et les normes de l'entreprise.
- Agir en tant que conseiller en SSE et principal point de contact, en fournissant des conseils opportuns, pratiques et efficaces sur les questions et les défis liés à la SSE.
- Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les intervenants à tous les niveaux de l'organisation, tant verticalement qu'interfonctionnellement.

Job Title: Goods Receipt Specialist

## Position Summary

The Goods Receipt Specialist is responsible for the timely receipt, booking, and storage of materials. The role records deviations in the TrackWise system and supports investigations. The incumbent ensures compliance with SOPs, GCP, cGMP, and safety requirements and monitors documentation practices within the eDMS.

## Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, GxP guidelines, and internal/external safety regulations
- Receive goods, post goods receipts in GPMS, and hand over shipments to freight carriers
- Perform high-bay warehouse picking activities and related WMS transactions
- Physically store materials and perform GPMS/WMS postings
- Execute required material movements, including transfers to external storage locations
- Operate machinery and equipment used for material handling
- Conduct inventory counts
- Clean facilities, machinery, and equipment according to instructions
- Support other departments as directed by supervisors

## Minimum Qualifications

- Completed vocational training in logistics
- At least two years of experience in industry or logistics
- Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and move heavier materials
- Very good German language skills, written and spoken
- Strong communication skills
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a multicultural environment
- Ability to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks
- Strong teamwork skills and resilience under stress
- Reliable, accurate, and efficient working style
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Preferred Qualifications

- Several years of experience in a regulated environment (e.g., pharmaceutical or food industry)
- Forklift license
- Class B driving license
- English language skills, written and spoken

This job description does not include all duties and responsibilities. Additional function-related instructions and assignments requested by management must be followed.

## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Warehouse

## Job Description

Job Title: Goods Receipt Specialist

Reports to: Team Leader Goods In

Career Band: 2

Division: Clinical Trial Division (CTD)

## Position Summary

The Goods Receipt Specialist is responsible for the timely receipt, booking, and storage of materials. The role records deviations in the TrackWise system and supports investigations. The incumbent ensures compliance with SOPs, GCP, cGMP, and safety requirements and monitors documentation practices within the eDMS.

## Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, GxP guidelines, and internal/external safety regulations
- Receive goods, post goods receipts in GPMS, and hand over shipments to freight carriers
- Perform high-bay warehouse picking activities and related WMS transactions
- Physically store materials and perform GPMS/WMS postings
- Execute required material movements, including transfers to external storage locations
- Operate machinery and equipment used for material handling
- Conduct inventory counts
- Clean facilities, machinery, and equipment according to instructions
- Support other departments as directed by supervisors

## Minimum Qualifications

- Completed vocational training in logistics
- At least two years of experience in industry or logistics
- Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and move heavier materials
- Very good German language skills, written and spoken
- Strong communication skills
- Ability to work independently under pressure in a multicultural environment
- Ability to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks
- Strong teamwork skills and resilience under stress
- Reliable, accurate, and efficient working style
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Preferred Qualifications

- Several years of experience in a regulated environment (e.g., pharmaceutical or food industry)
- Forklift license
- Class B driving license
- English language skills, written and spoken

This job description does not include all duties and responsibilities. Additional function-related instructions and assignments requested by management must be followed.

German:

## Interne Stellenbeschreibung

Job-Titel: Goods Receipt Specialist

Berichtet an: Team Leader Goods In

Karriere-Band: 2

## Zusammenfassende Positionsbeschreibung

Der Goods Receipt Specialist führt eine zeitgerechte Annahme, Einbuchung sowie Einlagerung von Materialien durch. Er erfasst Abweichungen im TrackWise-System und unterstützt Untersuchungen. Er stellt die Einhaltung gültiger SOPs, GCP-, cGMP- und Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften sicher und überwacht die Dokumentationspraxis im eDMS.

## Verantwortlichkeiten

- Einhaltung von SOPs, GxP-Richtlinien sowie internen und externen Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften
- Warenannahme, Wareneingangsbuchung im GPMS sowie Warenübergabe an Frachtführer
- Hochregallager-Kommissionierungen sowie Verbuchung im WMS
- Physische Einlagerung von Waren und Buchung im GPMS/WMS
- Durchführung notwendiger Warenbewegungen inklusive Transporte ins Aussenlager
- Bedienung von Maschinen und Ausrüstungen zur Warenbewegung
- Durchführung von Inventuren
- Reinigung von Räumlichkeiten, Maschinen und Ausrüstungen gemäss Anweisungen
- Einsatz in anderen Abteilungen gemäss Weisung der Vorgesetzten

## Minimale Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker
- Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Industrie/Logistik
- Fähigkeit länger zu stehen und zu laufen sowie schwere Materialien zu bewegen
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten
- Selbstständige Arbeitsweise auch unter Druck in einem multikulturellen Umfeld
- Fähigkeit, Zeitvorgaben einzuhalten und Tätigkeiten zu priorisieren
- Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Stressbeständigkeit
- Zuverlässige, genaue und effiziente Arbeitsweise
- Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)

## Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem regulierten Arbeitsumfeld (z. B. Pharma- oder Lebensmittelindustrie)
- Staplerführerschein
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Englische Sprachfertigkeiten in Wort und Schrift

Diese Stellenbeschreibung beschreibt nicht alle Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten. Weitere funktionsbezogene Anweisungen und Aufgaben sind entsprechend den Vorgaben der Vorgesetzten zu befolgen.

## Calendrier des travaux Norme (Mon-Fri) ## Conditions environnementales Entrepôt ## Description du poste Titre: Spécialiste de la réception des marchandises Rapports à : Chef d'équipe Bande professionnelle: 2 Division des essais cliniques ## Résumé du poste Le spécialiste de la réception des marchandises est responsable de la réception, de la réservation et de l'entreposage des documents en temps opportun. Le rôle enregistre les écarts dans le système TrackWise et soutient les enquêtes. Le titulaire s'assure de la conformité aux SOP, au GCP, au GMPc et aux exigences de sécurité et surveille les pratiques de documentation au sein du SGD électronique. ## Responsabilités - Assurer la conformité avec les SOP, les lignes directrices du GxP et les règlements de sécurité internes et externes - Recevoir des marchandises, poster des reçus de marchandises dans le SGGP et remettre les expéditions aux transporteurs de marchandises - Effectuer des activités de ramassage d'entrepôts à grande baie et des transactions connexes avec WMS - Entreposage physique du matériel et affichage GPMS/WMS - Exécuter les mouvements de matériel requis, y compris les transferts vers des sites de stockage externes - Fonctionnement des machines et équipements utilisés pour la manutention des matériaux - Effectuer des inventaires - Nettoyage des installations, des machines et de l'équipement selon les instructions - Appuyer les autres ministères conformément aux directives des superviseurs ## Qualités minimales - Formation professionnelle complète en logistique - Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans l'industrie ou la logistique - Capacité de se tenir debout et de marcher pendant de longues périodes et de déplacer des matériaux plus lourds - Très bonnes compétences en langue allemande, écrites et parlées - Fortes compétences en communication - Capacité de travailler de manière indépendante sous pression dans un environnement multiculturel - Capacité de respecter les délais et de hiérarchiser les tâches - Fortes compétences en travail d'équipe et résilience sous le stress - Style de travail fiable, précis et efficace - Compétence dans les applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) ##
• Qualifications privilégiées - Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un environnement réglementé (p. ex. industrie pharmaceutique ou alimentaire) - Licence de chariot élévateur - Permis de conduire de classe B - Compétences en langue anglaise, écrite et parlée Cette description de travail ne comprend pas toutes les tâches et responsabilités. Les instructions et les affectations supplémentaires demandées par la direction doivent être suivies. Il détecte les déviations dans le système TrackWise et soutient les enquêtes. Il veille à la conformité avec les SOP valides, le GCP, le GMPc et les règlements de sécurité au travail et surveille les pratiques de documentation dans le SGD électronique. ## Responsabilité - Conformité aux normes SOP, aux directives GxP et aux règlements internes et externes en matière de sécurité au travail - Acceptation des marchandises, réservation de réception des marchandises dans le SGGP et livraison des marchandises aux transporteurs - Cueillette et réservation d'entrepôt dans le WMS - Stockage physique des marchandises et réservation dans GPMS/WMS - Mise en œuvre des mouvements de marchandises nécessaires, y compris le transport vers l'entrepôt extérieur - Fonctionnement des machines et équipements pour le mouvement des marchandises - Mise en œuvre des inventaires - Nettoyage des locaux, des machines et du matériel conformément aux instructions - Déploiement dans d'autres départements selon les instructions des supérieurs ##
• Qualifications minimales - Formation complétée en tant que logisticien - Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans l'industrie/logistique - Capacité à se tenir debout et à marcher plus longtemps et à déplacer des matériaux lourds - Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture - Bonnes compétences en communication - Travail indépendant même sous pression dans un environnement multiculturel - Capacité de respecter les délais et de prioriser les activités - Niveau élevé de travail d'équipe et de résistance au stress - Méthodes de travail fiables, précises et efficaces - Bonne connaissance de MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) ## Titres préférés - Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans un milieu de travail réglementé (p. ex. industrie pharmaceutique ou alimentaire) - Permis de conduire de chariot élévateur - Permis de conduire de catégorie B - Compétences linguistiques anglaises en paroles et en écriture Cette description de travail ne décrit pas toutes les tâches et responsabilités. jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

7 1/2 hr shift

## Environmental Conditions

Warehouse

## Job Description

## Zusammenfassung der Funktion:

Selbstständige Bearbeitung standardisierter und komplexerer Versandprozesse und Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft. Die Tätigkeit umfasst die physische und systemseitige Kommissionierung, Verpackung, Versandvorbereitung sowie die Übergabe der Sendungen an Logistikdienstleister falls erforderlich. Dabei werden alle internen Arbeitsanweisungen (SOPs), Qualitätsanforderungen sowie nationale und internationale Transportvorschriften eingehalten. Der Material Handler unterstützt einen sicheren und termingerechten Versand von Ambient-, Kühl- und Tiefkühlsendungen weltweit.**lhre Hauptaufgaben:**Bearbeitung und selbständige Priorisierung der täglichen standardisierte VersandauftrageKommissionieren und Verpacken von komplexen klinischen PrüfmaterialienBearbeitung unterschiedlicher Versandarten/temperaturgeführter SendungenSelbständige Erstellung der VersanddokumentationUnterstützung neuer MitarbeiterDokumentation gemäß GMP/GDPErste Fehleranalyse und Unterstützung bei CAPAs und DeviationsEinhaltung aller SOPSSicherstellung der GDP ComplianceOrdnung und Sauberkeit (SS)Mitarbeit bei LEAN-, PPI- und Kontinuierliche ProzessverbesserungReinigung und Ordnung des Arbeitsbereiches gemäß 5S-Prinzipien**
• Ihr Profil:**Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Lager, Produktion oder vergleichbare QualifikationBerufserfahrung im Bereich Lagerlogistik, Versand oder Supply Chain, vorzugsweise in einem GMP-/GDP-regulierten UmfeldErfahrung im Umgang mit Warehouse Management Systemen (WMS) und MS OfficeGute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Englisch ist von Vorteil.Strukturierte, sorgfältige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise.Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie Verständnis fi.ir GMP-, GDP- und Qualitätsanforderungen.Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und BelastbarkeitFähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Termine zuverlässig einzuhalten.Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterbildung (z. B. IATA, GDP, Gefahrgut).

jobs.title: Metrology Supervisor
jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Flex with On Call Duty

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

When you join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll be part of an inquisitive team that shares your passion for exploration and discovery. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create significant contributions to the world.

## DESCRIPTION

How you will make an impact:

The Metrology Supervisor is responsible for leading metrology and calibration activities in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. This role ensures that all measuring and test equipment is compliant with regulatory requirements and supports product quality, patient safety, and data integrity. The position oversees a team of technicians, ensures adherence to ALCOA+ principles, and maintains inspection readiness at all times.

What you will do:

- Lead and supervise daily metrology and calibration operations within GMP areas (manufacturing, QC, laboratories, utilities)
- Ensure all instruments and systems are calibrated and maintained in compliance with GMP, FDA, EMA, and ISO standards
- Own and manage the calibration lifecycle: scheduling, execution, review, approval, and archival
- Ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) in all calibration records and electronic systems
- Review and approve calibration certificates, deviations, and out-of-tolerance (OOT) investigations
- Initiate and lead deviation, CAPA, and change control processes related to metrology activities
- Maintain full traceability to national/international standards (e.g., NIST)
- Support regulatory inspections and customer audits
- Ensure metrology processes align with validated systems and computerized system validation (CSV) requirements
- Collaborate with QA, Validation, Engineering, and Manufacturing to support equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Define and track KPIs related to compliance, turnaround time, and right-first-time performance
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance compliance and efficiency
- Train, qualify, and develop metrology personnel in GMP and technical competencies
- Adhere to general cGMP rules, Quality policies, procedures and instruction as rolled out by the Quality function and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives and deviation reporting and follow-up
- Adhere to general safety rules, policies, procedures and instructions as rolled out by the EHSS functions and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to safety initiatives and issues as well as near miss reporting and follow-up
- Maintain commitment to Thermo Fisher Scientific values and adherence to ethics and legal compliance standards
- Take personal accountability for presence, performance, and productivity for the achievements of defined objectives
- Think and act with a customer-centric mindset
- Embrace intellectual curiosity and Practical Process Improvement (PPI)

Reporting relationships:

The position reports to Director, Manufacturing Engineering and interacts with Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, EHSS, Quality Assurance, Service Contractors, and other team members.

## REQUIREMENTS

Education:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or related technical discipline

Experience & Competencies:

- 5–8+ years of experience in metrology/calibration within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment
- Prior experience supervising or leading teams strongly preferred
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (21 CFR Parts 210/211, Annex 11), FDA/EMA expectations
- Solid understanding of measurement uncertainty, risk-based calibration, and critical instrumentation
- Experience with CSV and data integrity requirements (ALCOA+)
- Familiarity with deviation/CAPA systems and quality management systems (QMS)
- Experience with electronic calibration and asset management systems

Additional Requirements:

- Strong leadership and team development
- Deep understanding of GMP compliance and regulatory expectations
- High attention to detail and documentation accuracy
- Root cause analysis and problem-solving (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone)
- Cross-functional communication and stakeholder management
- Audit readiness mindset

Flex con On Call Duty

## Condizioni ambientali

Aderenza a tutte le buone pratiche di fabbricazione (GMP) standard di sicurezza, cleanroom: no prodotti per capelli, gioielli, trucco, smalto per unghie, profumo, piercing a vista, capelli facciali ecc... consentiti, Office, un certo grado di PPE (attrezzatura di protezione personale) richiesto (vetri di sicurezza, abiti, guanti, camice da laboratorio, tappi per orecchie ecc.)

## Descrizione del lavoro

Quando ti unisci a noi alla Thermo Fisher Scientific, sarai parte di un team inquisitivo che condivide la tua passione per l'esplorazione e la scoperta. Con ricavi di oltre 40 miliardi di dollari e il più grande investimento in R&D nel settore, diamo alle nostre persone le risorse e le possibilità di creare contributi significativi al mondo.

## DESCRIZIONE

Come si farà un impatto:

Il Metrology Supervisor è responsabile delle principali attività di metrologia e taratura in un ambiente farmaceutico regolamentato da GMP. Questo ruolo garantisce che tutte le apparecchiature di misura e test siano conformi ai requisiti normativi e supportino la qualità del prodotto, la sicurezza del paziente e l'integrità dei dati. La posizione supervisiona un team di tecnici, assicura l'aderenza ai principi ALCOA+ e mantiene sempre la disponibilità di ispezione.

Cosa farai:

- Guidare e supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane di metrologia e taratura nelle aree GMP (produzione, QC, laboratori, utilità)
- Assicurarsi che tutti gli strumenti e i sistemi siano calibrati e mantenuti in conformità agli standard GMP, FDA, EMA e ISO
- Possedere e gestire il ciclo di vita di calibrazione: pianificazione, esecuzione, revisione, approvazione e archivio
- Assicurare l'integrità dei dati (ALCOA+) in tutti i record di calibrazione e sistemi elettronici
- Valutazione e taratura approvano certificati, deviazioni e indagini di tolleranza (OOT)
- Avviare e condurre deviazione, CAPA e cambiare i processi di controllo relativi alle attività di metrologia
- Mantenere la piena tracciabilità agli standard nazionali/internazionali (ad esempio, NIST)
- Sostegno ispezioni normative e audit dei clienti
- Assicurare processi di metrologia allineati con sistemi convalidati e requisiti di validazione del sistema computerizzato (CSV)
- Collabora con QA, Validazione, Ingegneria e Produzione per supportare la qualificazione delle attrezzature (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Definire e monitorare i KPI relativi alla conformità, il tempo di svolta e le prestazioni di destra
- Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo per migliorare la conformità e l'efficienza
- Formare, qualificare e sviluppare personale metrologico in GMP e competenze tecniche
- Adeguarsi alle regole cGMP generali, alle politiche di qualità, alle procedure e alle istruzioni presentate dalla funzione Qualità e approvate dalla gestione del sito
- Contribuire attivamente a continue iniziative di miglioramento della qualità e alla segnalazione e al follow-up delle deviazioni
- Adeguarsi alle regole generali di sicurezza, alle politiche, alle procedure e alle istruzioni presentate dalle funzioni EHSS e approvate dalla gestione del sito
- Contribuire attivamente a iniziative e problemi di sicurezza, nonché vicino a segnalazioni e follow-up mancanti
- Mantenere l'impegno per i valori scientifici Thermo Fisher e rispettare gli standard etici e legali
- Prendere la responsabilità personale per la presenza, le prestazioni e la produttività per i risultati di obiettivi definiti
- Pensare e agire con una mentalità orientata al cliente
- Abbraccia la curiosità intellettuale e il miglioramento del processo pratico (PPI)

Rapporti:

La posizione riporta a Direttore, Ingegneria manifatturiera e interagisce con Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, EHSS, Quality Assurance, Service Contractors e altri membri del team.

## PRESCRIZIONI

Istruzione:

- Laurea in Ingegneria, Scienze della Vita, o disciplina tecnica correlata

Esperienza e competenze:

- 5-8+ anni di esperienza in metrologia/calibrazione all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico o biotecnologico GMP
- Prima esperienza di supervisione o squadre leader fortemente preferito
- Forte conoscenza delle normative GMP (21 parti CFR 210/211, allegato 11), aspettative FDA/EMA
- Solida comprensione dell'incertezza di misura, della calibrazione basata sul rischio e della strumentazione critica
- Esperienza con CSV e requisiti di integrità dei dati (ALCOA+)
- Familiarità con sistemi di deviazione/CAPA e sistemi di gestione della qualità (QMS)
- Esperienza con sistemi di taratura elettronica e gestione patrimoniale

Requisiti aggiuntivi:

- Forte leadership e sviluppo di team
- Profonda comprensione della conformità GMP e delle aspettative normative
- Alta attenzione ai dettagli e precisione della documentazione
- Analisi della causa della radice e risoluzione dei problemi (ad esempio, 5 Perché, Fishbone)
- Comunicazione interfunzionale e gestione degli stakeholder
- Audit mentalità di prontezza

## Work Schedule

Flex with On Call Duty

## Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

## Job Description

When you join us at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll be part of an inquisitive team that shares your passion for exploration and discovery. With revenues of more than $40 billion and the largest investment in R&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and chances to create significant contributions to the world.

## DESCRIPTION

How you will make an impact:

The Metrology Supervisor is responsible for leading metrology and calibration activities in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment. This role ensures that all measuring and test equipment is compliant with regulatory requirements and supports product quality, patient safety, and data integrity. The position oversees a team of technicians, ensures adherence to ALCOA+ principles, and maintains inspection readiness at all times.

What you will do:

- Lead and supervise daily metrology and calibration operations within GMP areas (manufacturing, QC, laboratories, utilities)
- Ensure all instruments and systems are calibrated and maintained in compliance with GMP, FDA, EMA, and ISO standards
- Own and manage the calibration lifecycle: scheduling, execution, review, approval, and archival
- Ensure data integrity (ALCOA+) in all calibration records and electronic systems
- Review and approve calibration certificates, deviations, and out-of-tolerance (OOT) investigations
- Initiate and lead deviation, CAPA, and change control processes related to metrology activities
- Maintain full traceability to national/international standards (e.g., NIST)
- Support regulatory inspections and customer audits
- Ensure metrology processes align with validated systems and computerized system validation (CSV) requirements
- Collaborate with QA, Validation, Engineering, and Manufacturing to support equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ)
- Define and track KPIs related to compliance, turnaround time, and right-first-time performance
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance compliance and efficiency
- Train, qualify, and develop metrology personnel in GMP and technical competencies
- Adhere to general cGMP rules, Quality policies, procedures and instruction as rolled out by the Quality function and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement initiatives and deviation reporting and follow-up
- Adhere to general safety rules, policies, procedures and instructions as rolled out by the EHSS functions and endorsed by the site management
- Actively contribute to safety initiatives and issues as well as near miss reporting and follow-up
- Maintain commitment to Thermo Fisher Scientific values and adherence to ethics and legal compliance standards
- Take personal accountability for presence, performance, and productivity for the achievements of defined objectives
- Think and act with a customer-centric mindset
- Embrace intellectual curiosity and Practical Process Improvement (PPI)

Reporting relationships:

The position reports to Director, Manufacturing Engineering and interacts with Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, EHSS, Quality Assurance, Service Contractors, and other team members.

## REQUIREMENTS

Education:

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or related technical discipline

Experience & Competencies:

- 5–8+ years of experience in metrology/calibration within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment
- Prior experience supervising or leading teams strongly preferred
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (21 CFR Parts 210/211, Annex 11), FDA/EMA expectations
- Solid understanding of measurement uncertainty, risk-based calibration, and critical instrumentation
- Experience with CSV and data integrity requirements (ALCOA+)
- Familiarity with deviation/CAPA systems and quality management systems (QMS)
- Experience with electronic calibration and asset management systems

Additional Requirements:

- Strong leadership and team development
- Deep understanding of GMP compliance and regulatory expectations
- High attention to detail and documentation accuracy
- Root cause analysis and problem-solving (e.g., 5 Whys, Fishbone)
- Cross-functional communication and stakeholder management
- Audit readiness mindset

Der Metrology Supervisor ist für die Leitung von Messtechnik- und Kalibrierungsaktivitäten in einer GMP-regulierten pharmazeutischen Umgebung verantwortlich. Erfahrung & Kompetenzen:

Zusätzliche Anforderungen:

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
DESCRIPTION:
Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to advancing clinical research. As a Client Services Project Manager I, you'll support clinical trials by managing project documentation, coordinating supply chain activities, and ensuring consistent delivery of services. Work closely with internal teams and clients to support study success while maintaining the highest quality standards. You'll handle project planning, documentation management, and cross-functional coordination to meet timelines and client expectations.
REQUIREMENTS:
• Bachelor's degree required, no prior experience required, preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry
• Preferred Fields of Study: healthcare, supply chain management, life sciences, or related field
• Project Management certification from recognized institution beneficial
• Strong understanding of GMP/GxP principles and quality management systems
• Demonstrated project management skills with ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and Project
• Experience with enterprise systems like Salesforce, GPMS, and TrackWise preferred
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Detail-oriented with excellent organizational and documentation abilities
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams
• Fluent English required, additional languages beneficial
• Experience coordinating with teams and managing stakeholder relationships
• Ability to analyze data and generate clear, accurate reports
• Focus on quality service and continuous improvement
• Adaptable to changing priorities while maintaining attention to detail
• Travel to client sites or other facilities may be required

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Rotational shift nights/weekends

## Environmental Conditions

Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance, Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Cold Room/Freezers -22degreesF/-6degrees C, No contact lens allowed; prescriptive glasses will be provided

## Job Description

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

The state-of-the-art multi-purpose manufacturing facility is crafted for large-scale production of biologics and has high expansion potential. After completion of construction activities, our site in Lengnau will offer highly flexible biomanufacturing technologies, from development to large-scale production including stainless steel equipment to meet our customer needs.

## Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation

Location: Lengnau

## Fixed contract until the end of 2026.

As a **Manufacturing Specialist / Media & Buffer Preparation**, you conduct the production of recombinant products by operating automated production equipment and support project teams in the design, commissioning, qualification and validation of new production lines for recombinant products.

## Your responsibilities:

- Support operational readiness for Media buffer preparation, equipment preparation and cleaning.
- Participates in Technology Transfer of new products. Supports CVQ, PQ, Process Validation execution
- Responsible for the day-to-day execution of manufacturing activities in media & buffer preparation, equipment cleaning and preparation.
- Owns Work Instructions and SOP in their area
- Support Manufacturing Excellence to run robustly and efficiently.
- Participates in defining robust process parameters during routine manufacturing campaigns
- Participate in New Product Introduction activities

## Your qualifications:

- Degree in pharmaceutical, food or chemistry
- 1-3 years successful experience in pharmaceuticals operations in a GMP relevant environment
- Experience in pharmaceutical industry
- Hands on mentality
- Shift work is expected
- On-call duties is expected

**We offer** driven remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Se i nostri clienti stanno accelerando la ricerca sulle scienze della vita, risolvendo sofisticate sfide analitiche, aumentando l'efficienza nei loro laboratori, migliorando la salute dei pazienti attraverso la diagnostica o lo sviluppo e la produzione di terapie che cambiano la vita, siamo qui per aiutarli. • Offriamo ** remunerazione guidata, bonus annuale piano di incentivazione, assistenza sanitaria e una gamma di benefici per i dipendenti. Thermo Fisher Scientific offre un'occupazione con un'organizzazione innovativa e intenzionale, e prospettive di carriera e sviluppo eccezionali.
• Offriamo un'emozionante cultura aziendale che è sinonimo di integrità, intensità, coinvolgimento e innovazione! La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e più sicuro. Guarda come i nostri colleghi spiegano 5 motivi per lavorare con noi. Come un team di 100.000+ colleghi, condividiamo un insieme comune di valori - Integrità, Intensità, Innovazione e Coinvolgimento - lavorando insieme per accelerare la ricerca, risolvere complesse sfide scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione tecnologica e sostenere i pazienti bisognosi. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, dove vengono valutate esperienze, sfondi e prospettive diverse.

jobs.description:
## Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

## Environmental Conditions

Office

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

This is an outstanding chance for a committed and ambitious professional to join our project management team at Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. The Senior Project Manager, Client Services Distribution leads all aspects of leadership and is responsible for the actions of project managers and project support associates. You will work closely to guarantee the timely and flawless delivery of clinical supplies projects and successfully implement processes to improve efficiency. While you will not coordinate day-to-day project activities, you will lead all aspects of your team's client portfolio, ensuring outstanding client happiness and consistent business delivery.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, mentor, and conduct yearly evaluations for Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Support Associates. Put into effect Performance Improvement Plans when needed.
- Establish goals for direct reports in alignment with company initiatives and vision.
- Direct the selection of projects and clients managed by the project management team, ensuring accurate and consistent delivery of customer projects.
- Provide assistance for customer issues advanced by Project Managers and Associate Project Managers.
- Identify, develop, and implement process improvements to improve overall efficiency and productivity.
- Address all personnel issues, timecard maintenance, and job descriptions for support associates.
- Participate in sales and marketing activities, including customer kickoffs, teleconferences, customer visits, audits, estimates, and quotations.
- Initiate and maintain continuous communication with appropriate departments.
- Provide regular training, including system and SOP training.
- Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices in all areas of responsibility.
- Demonstrate and promote the company vision and values.

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Accredited degree, preferably in a health-related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 5-7 years of experience supporting project management teams.
- Previous work experience in the Healthcare field required.
- 2 years of management experience.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent relationship building.
- Proven experience managing teams and working with customers in dynamic environments.
- In-depth understanding of clinical trials and business services.
- Proficient in using company SOPs and Quality standards.
- Excellent organizational, planning, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong customer management skills; proactive in anticipating and responding to client needs.
- Experience with both detailed execution and strategic orientation.

## Diversity and Inclusion Proficiencies:

- Drives Growth
- Builds Customer Allegiance
- Communicates Openly
- Builds Organizational Relationships

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

## Position Summary:

This is an outstanding chance for a committed and ambitious professional to join our project management team at Thermo Fisher Scientific in Allschwil. The Senior Project Manager, Client Services Distribution leads all aspects of leadership and is responsible for the actions of project managers and project support associates. You will work closely to guarantee the timely and flawless delivery of clinical supplies projects and successfully implement processes to improve efficiency. While you will not coordinate day-to-day project activities, you will lead all aspects of your team's client portfolio, ensuring outstanding client happiness and consistent business delivery.

## Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, mentor, and conduct yearly evaluations for Project Managers, Associate Project Managers, and Project Support Associates. Put into effect Performance Improvement Plans when needed.
- Establish goals for direct reports in alignment with company initiatives and vision.
- Direct the selection of projects and clients managed by the project management team, ensuring accurate and consistent delivery of customer projects.
- Provide assistance for customer issues advanced by Project Managers and Associate Project Managers.
- Identify, develop, and implement process improvements to improve overall efficiency and productivity.
- Address all personnel issues, timecard maintenance, and job descriptions for support associates.
- Participate in sales and marketing activities, including customer kickoffs, teleconferences, customer visits, audits, estimates, and quotations.
- Initiate and maintain continuous communication with appropriate departments.
- Provide regular training, including system and SOP training.
- Adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices in all areas of responsibility.
- Demonstrate and promote the company vision and values.

## Minimum Requirements/Qualifications:

- Accredited degree, preferably in a health-related field; advanced degree preferred.
- 5-7 years of experience supporting project management teams.
- Previous work experience in the Healthcare field required.
- 2 years of management experience.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including excellent relationship building.
- Proven experience managing teams and working with customers in dynamic environments.
- In-depth understanding of clinical trials and business services.
- Proficient in using company SOPs and Quality standards.
- Excellent organizational, planning, and analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines.
- Strong customer management skills; proactive in anticipating and responding to client needs.
- Experience with both detailed execution and strategic orientation.

## Diversity and Inclusion Proficiencies:

- Drives Growth
- Builds Customer Allegiance
- Communicates Openly
- Builds Organizational Relationships
- Adapts to Process Improvement Environments

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. ist der weltweit führende Partner für die Wissenschaft mit einem Umsatz von 40 Mrd. USD und mehr als 120'000 Mitarbeitern in 60 Ländern. Unsere Mission ist es, unsere Kunden in die Lage zu versetzen, die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer zu machen.

Fisher Clinical Services GmbH ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. mit über 800 Mitarbeitern in der Schweiz und ist marktführend in den Bereichen Clinical Supply Chain Management Services und klinischer Prüfmusterherstellung sowie Logistik für Patienten weltweit. ## Operator

## Zusammenfassung der Funktion:

Effiziente, zeitgerechte und GMP-gerechte Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Abschluss von Herstellungs- und Verpackungsaufträgen inkl. Durchführung von Inprozess-Kontrollen (IPCs), sowie Durchführung der Reinigung von Ausrüstungs- und Maschinenteilen.

## Ihre Aufgaben:

- Effiziente, zeitgerechte und GMP-gerechte Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Abschluss von Herstellungs- und Verpackungsaufträgen inkl. Durchführung von Inprozess-Kontrollen (IPCs)
- Effiziente und GMP-gerechte Durchführung der Reinigung von Ausrüstungs- und Maschinenteilen sowie von den Produktionsräumen
- GMP-gerechtes Dokumentieren der durchgeführten Arbeiten
- Einhaltung der spezifischen Vorschriften bei der Herstellung und Verpackung von klinischen Prüfmustern, insbesondere der GMP-Regeln, Hygiene- und Sicherheitsvorschriften und der jeweils relevanten Standardarbeitsanweisungen (SOPs) und Auftragsinstruktionen
- Sicherstellung der aktiven, zeitnahen und angemessenen Kommunikation von Fortschritten und Schwierigkeiten an den Kollegen und Vorgesetzten
- Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Identifizierung, Kommunikation und Lösung von Problemen und Ineffizienz sowie bei Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten
- Arbeiten in Kühlzonen

## Ihr Profil:

- Vorzugsweise abgeschlossene Lehre in einem für die Stelle relevanten Bereich
- Erfahrung in der Pharma- oder Lebensmittelindustrie
- GMP-Erfahrung oder –Ausbildung vom Vorteil
- Beherrschung der deutschen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
- Befähigung zur angemessener, guter Kommunikation mit Kollegen und Vorgesetzten in deutscher Sprache (Wort und Schrift)
- Fähigkeit, Zeitvorgaben einzuhalten

## Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

From sample to knowledge to results, the Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry business develops and manufactures leading-edge chromatography and mass spectrometry instruments, consumables, and software solutions for customers working in the analytical sciences (routine testing markets) and scientific research. Our complete workflow solutions enable productivity and efficiency for customers performing food and beverage testing and manufacturing, environmental and industrial testing, biopharma QA/QC, toxicology, and anti-doping. For scientific research customers, our products support a range of focus areas, including proteomics, metabolomics, drug discovery, and clinical research.

**Location:** Switzerland / remote

**Discover Impactful Work** As an **Account Manager** at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll support sales growth and customer success for our advanced analytical and scientific instruments. Working in scientific instrument solutions, you'll help customers make informed decisions in research, quality control, and process improvement. You'll develop and expand customer relationships while representing our comprehensive portfolio of instruments, consumables, and services across diverse markets including pharmaceutical, environmental, industrial, food safety, healthcare, and academic research.

**A Day in the Life:** Develop and grow customer relationships by understanding scientific, technical, and business requirements and providing consultative solutions across our portfolio of analytical instruments, consumables, and services. Build and execute strategic sales plans, identify new opportunities, deliver compelling presentations, negotiate effectively, and collaborate with internal teams to drive customer success and achieve sales objectives.

## What to expect:

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve growth objectives.
- Build, maintain, and expand relationships with new and existing customers.
- Understand customer laboratory workflows, applications, and business needs.
- Provide consultative guidance on analytical instrumentation, consumables, and services.
- Identify and develop sales opportunities across pharmaceutical, environmental, industrial, food safety, healthcare, and academic research markets.
- Deliver technical and commercial presentations to customers and stakeholders.
- Manage negotiations and support customers throughout the sales process.
- Maintain accurate opportunity and customer information using CRM systems such as Salesforce.
- Collaborate effectively with internal commercial, technical, and service teams.
- Travel up to 70% to support customers and business development activities.

## Keys to Success:

## Education

- Master's degree plus 5 years of sales experience in analytical instrument markets or equivalent laboratory experience.
- Preferred fields of study include Chemistry, Biology, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.

## Experience

- Sales experience within analytical instrument markets or equivalent laboratory experience.
- Experience developing and executing strategic sales plans.
- Experience using consultative selling and negotiation approaches.
- Experience building and maintaining strong customer and internal stakeholder relationships.
- Experience working effectively in collaborative environments.

## Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

Fluency in German and English is required; French language skills are beneficial.Strong technical knowledge of analytical instrumentation and applications.Understanding of laboratory workflows and customer requirements across key market segments.Effective consultative selling and negotiation skills.Strong presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.Project management and organizational abilities.Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and the Microsoft Office suite.Ability to develop trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%.

## Competencies

- Customer focus
- Commercial acumen
- Consultative selling
- Relationship building
- Communication and influencing
- Strategic planning
- Collaboration
- Results orientation
- Integrity
- Intensity
- Innovation
- Involvement

**Benefits:** We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

## Descrizione del lavoro

Come parte del team Thermo Fisher Scientific, scoprirete un lavoro significativo che fa un impatto positivo su scala globale. Unisciti ai nostri colleghi nel portare la nostra missione in vita ogni giorno per consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Forniamo ai nostri team globali le risorse necessarie per raggiungere i singoli obiettivi di carriera, aiutando a superare la scienza, sviluppando soluzioni per alcune delle sfide più difficili del mondo, come proteggere l’ambiente, assicurarsi che il nostro cibo sia sicuro o aiutando a trovare cure per il cancro.

Dal campione alla conoscenza ai risultati, l'azienda Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry sviluppa e produce strumenti di cromatografia e spettrometria di massa, materiali di consumo e soluzioni software per i clienti che lavorano nelle scienze analitiche (mercati di test di routine) e nella ricerca scientifica. Le nostre soluzioni complete di flusso di lavoro consentono la produttività e l'efficienza per i clienti che eseguono test e produzione di alimenti e bevande, test ambientali e industriali, biofarmaci QA/QC, tossicologia e anti-doping. Per i clienti di ricerca scientifica, i nostri prodotti supportano una gamma di aree di focus, tra cui proteomics, metabolomics, scoperta della droga e ricerca clinica.

Posizione: Svizzera / telecomando

Scopri il lavoro d'impatto Come Account Manager presso Thermo Fisher Scientific, supporterai la crescita delle vendite e il successo del cliente per i nostri avanzati strumenti analitici e scientifici. Lavorando in soluzioni di strumenti scientifici, aiuterai i clienti a prendere decisioni informate nella ricerca, nel controllo della qualità e nel miglioramento dei processi. Potrai sviluppare e ampliare le relazioni con i clienti, rappresentando il nostro portafoglio completo di strumenti, materiali di consumo e servizi in diversi mercati, tra cui farmaceutico, ambientale, industriale, sicurezza alimentare, sanità e ricerca accademica.

A Day in the Life: Sviluppare e far crescere i rapporti con i clienti comprendendo i requisiti scientifici, tecnici e aziendali e fornendo soluzioni consultive nel nostro portafoglio di strumenti analitici, materiali di consumo e servizi. Costruire ed eseguire piani di vendita strategici, identificare nuove opportunità, fornire presentazioni convincenti, negoziare in modo efficace e collaborare con i team interni per guidare il successo del cliente e raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita.

## Cosa aspettarsi:

- Sviluppare ed eseguire piani strategici di vendita per raggiungere gli obiettivi di crescita.
- Costruire, mantenere e espandere le relazioni con i clienti nuovi e esistenti.
- Comprendere i flussi di lavoro del laboratorio del cliente, le applicazioni e le esigenze aziendali.
- Fornire indicazioni consultive su strumentazione analitica, materiali di consumo e servizi.
- Identificare e sviluppare opportunità di vendita nei mercati della ricerca farmaceutica, ambientale, industriale, alimentare, sanitaria e accademica.
- Consegnare presentazioni tecniche e commerciali a clienti e stakeholder.
- Gestire i negoziati e supportare i clienti durante il processo di vendita.
- Mantenere l'opportunità accurata e le informazioni del cliente utilizzando sistemi CRM come Salesforce.
- Collabora efficacemente con i team commerciali, tecnici e di assistenza interni.
- Viaggiate fino al 70% per supportare clienti e attività di sviluppo aziendale.

## Le chiavi di successo:

## Istruzione

- Laurea magistrale più 5 anni di esperienza di vendita nei mercati di strumenti analitici o esperienza di laboratorio equivalente.
- I campi di studio preferiti includono Chimica, Biologia, Scienze della Vita, o un campo scientifico correlato.

## Esperienza

- Esperienza di vendita nei mercati di strumenti analitici o esperienza di laboratorio equivalente.
- Sperimenta lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di piani strategici di vendita.
- Esperienza utilizzando approcci consultivi di vendita e negoziazione.
- Sperimentare la costruzione e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti e gli stakeholder interni.
- Esperienza di lavoro efficace in ambienti collaborativi.

## Conoscenza, abilità, abilità

È necessaria la fluidità in tedesco e in inglese; le competenze linguistiche francesi sono vantaggiose. Forte conoscenza tecnica della strumentazione analitica e delle applicazioni. Comprensione dei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio e dei requisiti dei clienti nei segmenti di mercato chiave. Efficace capacità consultive di vendita e di negoziazione. Forte presentazione, comunicazione e competenze interpersonali. Gestione del progetto e capacità organizzative. La competenza con sistemi CRM come Salesforce e la suite Microsoft Office. Capacità di sviluppare relazioni di fiducia con i clienti e gli stakeholder interni. Valida patente di guida e capacità di viaggiare fino al 70%.

## Competenze

- Obiettivo del cliente
- Acume commerciale
- Vendite consultive
- Costruzione di relazioni
- Comunicazione e influenza
- Pianificazione strategica
- Collaborazione
- Risultati dell'orientamento
- Integrità
- Intensità
- Innovazione
- Coinvolgimento

# Benefici. # Offriamo remunerazione competitiva, bonus annuale di incentivazione, assistenza sanitaria e una serie di benefici per i dipendenti. Thermo Fisher Scientific offre un'occupazione con un'organizzazione innovativa e intenzionale, e prospettive di carriera e sviluppo eccezionali. Offriamo un'emozionante cultura aziendale che è sinonimo di integrità, intensità, coinvolgimento e innovazione!

La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai nostri clienti di rendere il mondo più sano, più pulito e sicuro. Guarda come i nostri colleghi spiegano 5 motivi per lavorare con noi. In qualità di team di 100.000 colleghi, condividiamo un insieme comune di valori - Integrità, Intensità, Innovazione e Coinvolgimento - lavorando insieme per accelerare la ricerca, risolvere complesse sfide scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione tecnologica e sostenere i pazienti bisognosi.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, dove vengono valutate esperienze, sfondi e prospettive diverse.

# Apply today # [http://jobs.thermofisher.com](http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)

## Stellenbeschreibung

Als Teil des Teams von Thermo Fisher Scientific entdecken Sie sinnvolle Arbeiten, die sich weltweit positiv auswirken. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kollegen erwecken wir unsere Mission jeden Tag zum Leben, damit unsere Kunden die Welt gesünder, sauberer und sicherer machen können. Wir stellen unseren globalen Teams die Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um individuelle Karriereziele zu erreichen, und helfen gleichzeitig, die Wissenschaft einen Schritt weiter zu bringen, indem wir Lösungen für einige der schwierigsten Herausforderungen der Welt entwickeln, wie den Schutz der Umwelt, die Gewährleistung der Sicherheit unserer Lebensmittel oder die Suche nach Heilmitteln für Krebs.

Von der Probe über das Wissen bis hin zu den Ergebnissen entwickelt und produziert das Chromatographie- und Massenspektrometrie-Geschäft Spitzeninstrumente, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Softwarelösungen für Kunden, die in den analytischen Wissenschaften (routinemäßige Testmärkte) und in der wissenschaftlichen Forschung arbeiten. Unsere kompletten Workflow-Lösungen ermöglichen Produktivität und Effizienz für Kunden, die Lebensmittel- und Getränketests und -herstellung, Umwelt- und Industrietests, Biopharma QA / QC, Toxikologie und Anti-Doping durchführen. Für Kunden der wissenschaftlichen Forschung unterstützen unsere Produkte eine Reihe von Schwerpunktbereichen, darunter Proteomik, Metabolomik, Wirkstoffforschung und klinische Forschung.

**Standort:** Schweiz / Remote

**Entdecken Sie wirkungsvolle Arbeit ** Als **Account Manager** bei Thermo Fisher Scientific unterstützen Sie Umsatzwachstum und Kundenerfolg für unsere fortschrittlichen analytischen und wissenschaftlichen Instrumente. Mit wissenschaftlichen Instrumentenlösungen helfen Sie Ihren Kunden, fundierte Entscheidungen in den Bereichen Forschung, Qualitätskontrolle und Prozessverbesserung zu treffen. Sie entwickeln und erweitern Kundenbeziehungen, während Sie unser umfassendes Portfolio an Instrumenten, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Dienstleistungen in verschiedenen Märkten vertreten, darunter Pharmazie, Umwelt, Industrie, Lebensmittelsicherheit, Gesundheitswesen und akademische Forschung.

**Ein Tag im Leben: ** Entwickeln und erweitern Sie Kundenbeziehungen, indem Sie wissenschaftliche, technische und geschäftliche Anforderungen verstehen und beratende Lösungen für unser Portfolio an Analyseinstrumenten, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Dienstleistungen anbieten. Erstellen und implementieren Sie strategische Verkaufspläne, identifizieren Sie neue Möglichkeiten, liefern Sie überzeugende Präsentationen, verhandeln Sie effektiv und arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams zusammen, um den Kundenerfolg zu steigern und Verkaufsziele zu erreichen.

## Was zu erwarten ist:

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung strategischer Verkaufspläne zur Erreichung der Wachstumsziele.
- Aufbauen, pflegen und erweitern Sie Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden.
- Verstehen Sie die Workflows, Anwendungen und Geschäftsanforderungen von Kundenlabors.
- Beratung bei analytischen Instrumenten, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Dienstleistungen.
- Identifizieren und entwickeln Sie Absatzmöglichkeiten in den Bereichen Pharma, Umwelt, Industrie, Lebensmittelsicherheit, Gesundheitswesen und akademische Forschung.
- Liefern Sie technische und kommerzielle Präsentationen für Kunden und Stakeholder.
- Verwalten Sie Verhandlungen und unterstützen Sie Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses.
- Pflegen Sie genaue Gelegenheits- und Kundeninformationen mit CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce.
- Arbeiten Sie effektiv mit internen kaufmännischen, technischen und Serviceteams zusammen.
- Reisen Sie bis zu 70%, um Kunden und Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.

## Schlüssel zum Erfolg:

## Bildung

- Master-Abschluss plus 5 Jahre Verkaufserfahrung in analytischen Instrumentenmärkten oder gleichwertige Laborerfahrung.
- Bevorzugte Studienfächer sind Chemie, Biologie, Life Sciences oder ein verwandtes wissenschaftliches Gebiet.

- Verkaufserfahrung auf den Märkten für Analysegeräte oder gleichwertige Laborerfahrung.
- Erleben Sie die Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Verkaufspläne.
- Erfahrung mit beratenden Verkaufs- und Verhandlungsansätzen.

## Description de l'emploi

Dans le cadre de l'équipe Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous découvrirez un travail significatif qui a un impact positif à l'échelle mondiale. Rejoignez nos collègues pour donner vie à notre mission tous les jours afin de permettre à nos clients de rendre le monde plus sain, plus propre et plus sûr. Nous fournissons à nos équipes mondiales les ressources nécessaires pour atteindre des objectifs de carrière individuels tout en aidant à faire avancer la science en développant des solutions pour certains des défis les plus difficiles du monde, comme protéger l'environnement, s'assurer que nos aliments sont sûrs ou aider à trouver des remèdes pour le cancer.

De l'échantillon à la connaissance aux résultats, l'entreprise de chromatographie et de spectrométrie de masse développe et fabrique des instruments de chromatographie et de spectrométrie de masse de pointe, des consommables et des solutions logicielles pour les clients travaillant dans les sciences analytiques (marchés d'essais courants) et la recherche scientifique. Nos solutions complètes de workflow permettent la productivité et l'efficacité pour les clients qui effectuent des essais et des fabrications d'aliments et de boissons, des essais environnementaux et industriels, de l'AQ/QC biopharmaceutique, de la toxicologie et de l'antidopage. Pour les clients de la recherche scientifique, nos produits soutiennent une gamme de domaines d'intérêt, y compris la protéomique, la métabolomique, la découverte de médicaments et la recherche clinique.

Emplacement : Suisse / télécommande

Découvrez le travail utile En tant que responsable du compte chez Thermo Fisher Scientific, vous soutiendrez la croissance des ventes et le succès client pour nos instruments analytiques et scientifiques avancés. Travaillant dans des solutions d'instruments scientifiques, vous aiderez les clients à prendre des décisions éclairées en matière de recherche, de contrôle de la qualité et d'amélioration des processus. Vous développerez et élargirez les relations avec la clientèle tout en représentant notre vaste portefeuille d'instruments, de consommables et de services sur divers marchés, y compris les produits pharmaceutiques, environnementaux, industriels, la sécurité alimentaire, les soins de santé et la recherche universitaire.

Une journée dans la vie : Développer et développer les relations client en comprenant les exigences scientifiques, techniques et commerciales et en fournissant des solutions consultatives dans notre portefeuille d'instruments d'analyse, de consommables et de services. Élaborer et exécuter des plans stratégiques de vente, identifier de nouvelles possibilités, présenter des présentations convaincantes, négocier efficacement et collaborer avec des équipes internes pour stimuler le succès client et atteindre les objectifs de vente.

## À quoi s'attendre :

- Élaborer et exécuter des plans stratégiques de vente pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance.
- Établir, entretenir et développer des relations avec des clients nouveaux et existants.
- Comprendre les flux de travail, les applications et les besoins des laboratoires clients.
- Fournir des conseils consultatifs sur les instruments d'analyse, les consommables et les services.
- Identifier et développer les possibilités de vente sur les marchés de la recherche pharmaceutique, environnementale, industrielle, de la sécurité alimentaire, des soins de santé et universitaire.
- Fournir des présentations techniques et commerciales aux clients et aux intervenants.
- Gérer les négociations et soutenir les clients tout au long du processus de vente.
- Maintenez des informations précises sur les opportunités et les clients en utilisant des systèmes CRM tels que Salesforce.
- Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes de commerce, technique et de service.
- Voyage jusqu'à 70% pour soutenir les clients et les activités de développement d'entreprise.

## Les clés du succès :

## Éducation

- Maîtrise et 5 ans d'expérience commerciale dans les marchés des instruments d'analyse ou expérience équivalente en laboratoire.
- Les domaines d'études préférés comprennent la chimie, la biologie, les sciences de la vie ou un domaine scientifique connexe.

## Expérience

- Expérience de vente sur les marchés des instruments d'analyse ou expérience équivalente en laboratoire.
- Expérience de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de plans stratégiques de vente.
- Expérience en matière de vente et de négociation.
- Expérimentez l'établissement et le maintien de solides relations avec les clients et les intervenants internes.
- Expérience de travail efficace dans les environnements de collaboration.

## Connaissances, compétences, capacités

La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise; les compétences en français sont bénéfiques. Forte connaissance technique de l'instrumentation analytique et des applications. Compréhension des flux de travail en laboratoire et des besoins des clients sur les principaux segments du marché. Compétences efficaces en matière de vente et de négociation. Forte présentation, communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles. Gestion de projet et capacités organisationnelles. Compétence avec les systèmes CRM tels que Salesforce et la suite Microsoft Office. Capacité d'établir des relations de confiance avec les clients et les intervenants internes. Permis de conduire valide et capacité de voyager jusqu'à 70%.
